examples.english: Dawei quite likes his current job; not only can it challenge him, but he can also learn new things.

examples.chinese: 小黃要去便利商店領錢， 我請他幫我買杯咖啡。老闆去歐洲旅遊回來，買了荷蘭傳統的點心送給大家，叫我們去助理那裡領。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Huáng yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng qián, wǒ qǐng tā bāng wǒ mǎi bēi kāfēi. Lǎobǎn qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu huílái, mǎile Hélán chuántǒng de diǎnxin sòng gěi dàjiā, jiào wǒmen qù zhùlǐ nàlǐ lǐng.
examples.english: Xiao Huang is going to the convenience store to withdraw money; I asked him to buy me a cup of coffee. The boss came back from a trip to Europe and bought traditional Dutch snacks to give to everyone, and told us to pick them up from the assistant.

examples.chinese: 我們學校的禮堂看起來空間不大，其實坐得下一千人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de lǐtáng kàn qǐlái kōngjiān bú dà, qíshí zuò de xià yì qiān rén.
examples.english: Our school's auditorium looks like it doesn't have much space, but actually it can seat a thousand people.

examples.chinese: 現在大家都習慣用手機照相，一般的相機已經越來越少人使用了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài dàjiā dōu xíguàn yòng shǒujī zhàoxiàng, yìbān de xiàngjī yǐjīng yuèláiyuè shǎo rén shǐyòng le.
examples.english: Nowadays everyone is used to using their cell phones to take pictures; fewer and fewer people use regular cameras.

examples.chinese: 過年回家吃年夜飯，大家吃著吃著，就喝起酒來了，每喝幾杯，就唱一首歌，熱鬧極了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián huí jiā chī niányèfàn, dàjiā chī zhe chī zhe, jiù hē qǐ jiǔ lái le, měi hē jǐ bēi, jiù chàng yì shǒu gē, rènao jí le.
examples.english: When we go home for Chinese New Year to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, as everyone eats and eats, they start drinking; every few cups, they sing a song—it's extremely lively.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，不少大學教室裡的桌、椅是連在一起的，搬起來有點重。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, bùshǎo dàxué jiàoshì lǐ de zhuō, yǐ shì lián zài yìqǐ de, bān qǐlái yǒudiǎn zhòng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, the desks and chairs in many university classrooms are joined together, so they are a bit heavy to move.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese: 那家超市的生意非常好，因為他們進了很多特別的零食，大人、小孩都想嘗嘗看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshì de shēngyì fēicháng hǎo, yīnwèi tāmen jìn le hěn duō tèbié de língshí, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xiǎng chángchang kàn.
examples.english: That supermarket's business is very good because they have stocked many special snacks; both adults and children want to taste them.

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 那個人看起來很神祕，大家都不知道他從哪裡來、做什麼工作。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge rén kàn qǐlái hěn shénmì, dàjiā dōu bù zhīdào tā cóng nǎlǐ lái, zuò shénme gōngzuò.
examples.english: That person looks very mysterious; everyone doesn't know where he comes from or what job he does.

examples.chinese: 臺灣一般舊公寓的房子大約三十多坪，有客廳、廚房、一間浴室和三間臥房。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yìbān jiù gōngyù de fángzi dàyuē sānshí duō píng, yǒu kètīng, chúfáng, yì jiān yùshì hé sān jiān wòfáng.
examples.english: A typical old apartment in Taiwan is about thirty-something ping, with a living room, a kitchen, one bathroom, and three bedrooms.

examples.chinese: 大人應該把刀子放在安全的地方，要不然小孩子碰了，可能會受傷。
examples.pinyin: Dàrén yīnggāi bǎ dāozi fàng zài ānquán de dìfāng, yàobùrán xiǎoháizi pèng le, kěnéng huì shòushāng.
examples.english: Adults should put knives in a safe place; otherwise, if children touch them, they might get hurt.

examples.chinese: 小元昨天剛買了一件八千元的大衣，沒想到那家服裝店今天打三折，他太吃虧了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoyuán zuótiān gāng mǎi le yī jiàn bāqiān yuán de dàyī, méi xiǎngdào nà jiā fúzhuāngdiàn jīntiān dǎ sān zhé, tā tài chīkuī le.
examples.english: Xiaoyuan just bought an 8,000-yuan coat yesterday; unexpectedly, that clothing store is having a 70% off sale today—he really suffered a loss.

examples.chinese: 像踢足球那樣的運動，對年紀大的人不太合適。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng tī zúqiú nàyàng de yùndòng, duì niánjì dà de rén bù tài héshì.
examples.english: Sports like playing soccer are not very suitable for older people.

examples.chinese: 那位大明星身上穿的、手上戴的 ，都是有名的牌子。經理做事態度認真、負責，我從他身上學到了很多做人做事的道理。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi dà míngxīng shēnshang chuān de, shǒushang dài de, dōu shì yǒumíng de páizi. Jīnglǐ zuòshì tàidù rènzhēn, fùzé, wǒ cóng tā shēnshang xué dào le hěn duō zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ.
examples.english: What that big star wears on her body and on her hands are all famous brands. The manager's work attitude is serious and responsible; I have learned many principles of how to conduct myself and do things from him.

examples.chinese: 金小姐穿上這件淺色的上衣， 看起來更年輕、更有精神了。這個衣櫃有點兒淺，這件厚大衣掛不進去，就算掛進去了， 門也關不起來。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiǎojiě chuān shàng zhè jiàn qiǎnsè de shàngyī, kàn qǐlái gèng niánqīng, gèng yǒu jīngshén le. Zhège yīguì yǒudiǎnr qiǎn, zhè jiàn hòu dàyī guà bù jìnqù, jiùsuàn guà jìnqù le, mén yě guān bù qǐlái.
examples.english: When Miss Jin puts on this light-colored top, she looks younger and more energetic. This wardrobe is a bit shallow; this thick coat can't hang inside, and even if it could, the door wouldn't close.

examples.chinese: 客人：這雙皮鞋我穿起來太緊了， 可以幫我換大一點的嗎？ 店員：沒問題，我幫你拿大一號的。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén: Zhè shuāng píxié wǒ chuān qǐlái tài jǐn le, kěyǐ bāng wǒ huàn dà yīdiǎn de ma? Diànyuán: Méi wèntí, wǒ bāng nǐ ná dà yī hào de.
examples.english: Customer: This pair of leather shoes is too tight for me; can you help me exchange them for a bigger size? Clerk: No problem, I'll get you a size larger.

examples.chinese: 他們特地穿上情侶裝出門，好像要告訴大家他們是幸福的情侶。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen tèdì chuān shàng qínglǚzhuāng chūmén, hǎoxiàng yào gàosu dàjiā tāmen shì xìngfú de qínglǚ.
examples.english: They specially put on matching couple's clothes to go out, as if they want to tell everyone that they are a happy couple.

examples.chinese: 他們特地穿上情侶裝出門，好像要告訴大家他們是幸福的情侶。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen tèdì chuān shàng qínglǚzhuāng chūmén, hǎoxiàng yào gàosu dàjiā tāmen shì xìngfú de qínglǚ.
examples.english: They specially put on matching couple's clothes to go out, as if they want to tell everyone that they are a happy couple.

examples.chinese: 買襯衫的時候得注意肩膀的大小，太大或太小都不合適。
examples.pinyin: Mǎi chènshān de shíhou děi zhùyì jiānbǎng de dàxiǎo, tài dà huò tài xiǎo dōu bù héshì.
examples.english: When buying a shirt, you need to pay attention to the size of the shoulders; too big or too small are both unsuitable.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳不僅服務態度好，而且食物好吃又便宜，難怪大家都推薦我來嚐嚐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bùjǐn fúwù tàidù hǎo, érqiě shíwù hǎochī yòu piányi, nánguài dàjiā dōu tuījiàn wǒ lái chángchang.
examples.english: This restaurant not only has a good service attitude, but the food is also delicious and cheap; no wonder everyone recommended I come and try it.

examples.chinese: 爺爺在這棟公寓住了十年了，搬家時，用了好幾個大箱子來裝東西。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zài zhè dòng gōngyù zhù le shí nián le, bānjiā shí, yòng le hǎo jǐ ge dà xiāngzi lái zhuāng dōngxi.
examples.english: Grandpa has lived in this apartment building for ten years; when moving, he used several large boxes to pack things.

examples.chinese: 這所大學有最新的電腦設備，提供學生很好的學習環境。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué yǒu zuìxīn de diànnǎo shèbèi, tígōng xuéshēng hěn hǎo de xuéxí huánjìng.
examples.english: This university has the latest computer equipment, providing students with a very good learning environment.

examples.chinese: 那對雙胞胎姐妹不但長得很像，連性格也一樣開朗、大方。
examples.pinyin: Nà duì shuāngbāotāi jiěmèi bùdàn zhǎng de hěn xiàng, lián xìnggé yě yíyàng kāilǎng, dàfāng.
examples.english: That pair of twin sisters not only look very much alike, but even their personalities are equally cheerful and generous.

examples.chinese: 張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。 我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà. Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily. When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings.

examples.chinese: 除夕那天我送給父母一萬塊的紅包，祝福他們新年快樂，大吉大利！
examples.pinyin: Chúxī nà tiān wǒ sòng gěi fùmǔ yí wàn kuài de hóngbāo, zhùfú tāmen xīnnián kuàilè, dàjí dàlì!
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, I gave my parents a red envelope with ten thousand dollars, wishing them a happy New Year and great good fortune!

examples.chinese: 這兩部筆電的功能差異不大，就是價錢差了幾百塊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng bù bǐdiàn de gōngnéng chāyì bú dà, jiùshì jiàqián chà le jǐ bǎi kuài.
examples.english: The functional difference between these two laptops is not big; it's just that the price differs by a few hundred dollars.

examples.chinese: 朋友的孩子滿月了，我想送他一份禮，祝福他平平安安地長大。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou de háizi mǎnyuè le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí fèn lǐ, zhùfú tā píngpíng'ān'ān de zhǎngdà.
examples.english: My friend's child has reached one month old. I want to give him a present, wishing him to grow up safely and soundly.

examples.chinese: 那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le. Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english: Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's. Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 母親節那天，我親自做了一個大蛋糕，送給最親愛的媽媽。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīnjié nà tiān, wǒ qīnzì zuò le yī gè dà dàngāo, sòng gěi zuì qīn'ài de māma.
examples.english: On Mother's Day, I personally made a big cake and gave it to my dearest mother.

examples.chinese: 我哥哥開朗活潑、高大英俊，難怪有很多女生追求他。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge kāilǎng huópō, gāodà yīngjùn, nánguài yǒu hěnduō nǚshēng zhuīqiú tā.
examples.english: My older brother is cheerful and lively, tall and handsome; no wonder many girls pursue him.

examples.chinese: 黃教授不僅知識豐富、上課認真，還很關心學生，大家都很尊敬他。
examples.pinyin: Huáng jiàoshòu bùjǐn zhīshì fēngfù, shàngkè rènzhēn, hái hěn guānxīn xuéshēng, dàjiā dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
examples.english: Professor Huang not only has rich knowledge and teaches seriously, but also cares about students very much; everyone respects him greatly.

examples.chinese: 那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào. Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english: That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me. I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

examples.chinese: 下了好幾天的大雨，不但到處淹水，連我家養的雞、鴨也淹死了。
examples.pinyin: Xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, bùdàn dàochù yānshuǐ, lián wǒ jiā yǎng de jī, yā yě yān sǐ le.
examples.english: It rained heavily for several days; not only was there flooding everywhere, but even the chickens and ducks we raise at home drowned.

examples.chinese: 從這裡走路回家有一點兒距離，而且現在還下著大雨，我們還是搭計程車算了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ zǒulù huí jiā yǒu yīdiǎnr jùlí, érqiě xiànzài hái xiàzhe dàyǔ, wǒmen háishì dā jìchéngchē suàn le.
examples.english: Walking home from here is a bit of a distance, and it's still raining heavily now, so we might as well take a taxi.

examples.chinese: 我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne. Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english: When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought. That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese: 世界運動會的規模很大，每回舉辦時，五大洲的國家都會來參加。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè Yùndònghuì de guīmó hěn dà, měi huí jǔbàn shí, wǔ dà zhōu de guójiā dōu huì lái cānjiā.
examples.english: The scale of the World Games is very large; each time it is held, countries from five continents come to participate.

examples.chinese: 東部山區一連下了好幾天的大雨，有些房子倒了，公路也塌了，造成不少意外。
examples.pinyin: Dōngbù shānqū yíliàn xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, yǒuxiē fángzi dǎo le, gōnglù yě tā le, zàochéng bùshǎo yìwài.
examples.english: In the eastern mountain area, it rained heavily for several days in a row; some houses collapsed, and the highway also collapsed, causing many accidents.

examples.chinese: 救災工作不容易，一個人的力量是不夠的，得大家一起來。
examples.pinyin: Jiùzāi gōngzuò bù róngyì, yí ge rén de lìliàng shì bú gòu de, děi dàjiā yìqǐ lái.
examples.english: Disaster relief work is not easy; one person's strength is not enough—everyone needs to come together.

examples.chinese: 只有集合大家的力量，有錢出錢、有力出力，才能幫助災民早一點恢復正常生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jíhé dàjiā de lìliàng, yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, cái néng bāngzhù zāimín zǎo yìdiǎn huīfù zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
examples.english: Only by gathering everyone's strength—those with money contributing money, those with strength contributing strength—can we help the disaster victims return to normal life sooner.

examples.chinese: 九二一大地震時，臺灣人發揮了互相幫助的精神，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn shí, Táiwān rén fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: During the 921 earthquake, Taiwanese people brought out the spirit of helping one another, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩在這場大地震中失去了親人，實在太可憐了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái zài zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn zhōng shīqù le qīnrén, shízài tài kělián le.
examples.english: That child lost his family in this big earthquake; it's really too pitiful.

examples.chinese: 如果這個週末你沒有什麼打算，要不要跟我去看看臺灣規模最大的書店？
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhège zhōumò nǐ méiyǒu shénme dǎsuàn, yào bù yào gēn wǒ qù kànkan Táiwān guīmó zuì dà de shūdiàn?
examples.english: If you don't have any plans this weekend, do you want to go with me to see Taiwan's largest bookstore?

examples.chinese: 大寶明年有去英國留學的打算，所以找了家庭教師幫他補習， 希望提高英文程度。
examples.pinyin: Dàbǎo míngnián yǒu qù Yīngguó liúxué de dǎsuàn, suǒyǐ zhǎo le jiātíng jiàoshī bāng tā bǔxí, xīwàng tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù.
examples.english: Dabao plans to study abroad in the UK next year, so he found a private tutor to help him with cram tutoring, hoping to improve his English level.

examples.chinese: 大地震過後才幾天，這個災區的民眾除了收到許多衣服和食物，還收到五千萬元，讓大家又驚訝又感動。
examples.pinyin: Dà dìzhèn guòhòu cái jǐ tiān, zhège zāiqū de mínzhòng chúle shōudào xǔduō yīfu hé shíwù, hái shōudào wǔqiān wàn yuán, ràng dàjiā yòu jīngyà yòu gǎndòng.
examples.english: Only a few days after the major earthquake, the people in this disaster area not only received many clothes and food, but also received fifty million dollars, which made everyone both surprised and moved.

examples.chinese: 珍珍每天大約看兩個小時的臺灣連續劇，目的是要(訓)練自己的中文聽力。大雄常利用週末練(習)書法，所以漢字寫得比其他同學都好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhēn měitiān dàyuē kàn liǎng ge xiǎoshí de Táiwān liánxùjù, mùdì shì yào xùnliàn zìjǐ de Zhōngwén tīnglì. Dàxióng cháng lìyòng zhōumò liànxí shūfǎ, suǒyǐ Hànzì xiě de bǐ qítā tóngxué dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english: Zhenzhen watches about two hours of Taiwanese TV dramas every day; her purpose is to train her Chinese listening comprehension. Daxiong often uses his weekends to practice calligraphy, so he writes Chinese characters more beautifully than any of his classmates.

examples.chinese: 那家動物餐廳的空間很大，可以讓客人的小動物自由自在地活動。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā dòngwù cāntīng de kōngjiān hěn dà, kěyǐ ràng kèrén de xiǎo dòngwù zìyóuzìzài de huódòng.
examples.english: That animal restaurant has a lot of space, allowing guests' small pets to move around freely and fancy-free.

examples.chinese: 公司的生產部門這個月規劃了員工旅遊，有三個不同地點讓大家選擇。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de shēngchǎn bùmén zhège yuè guīhuà le yuángōng lǚyóu, yǒu sān ge bùtóng dìdiǎn ràng dàjiā xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The company's production department planned an employee trip this month, with three different locations for everyone to choose from.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The travel itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as sightseeing, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 我家在大馬路旁，從早到晚噪音不斷，嚴重影響了生活品質，所以決定搬家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài dà mǎlù páng, cóng zǎo dào wǎn zàoyīn bùduàn, yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng le shēnghuó pǐnzhí, suǒyǐ juédìng bānjiā.
examples.english: My home is next to a major road, and there is constant noise from morning till night, which has seriously affected our quality of life, so we decided to move.

examples.chinese: 現在突然下起了大雨，我們的計畫被破壞了，恐怕今天所有的活動都必須重新安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà bèi pòhuài le, kǒngpà jīntiān suǒyǒu de huódòng dōu bìxū chóngxīn ānpái.
examples.english: Now it has suddenly started raining heavily, and our plans have been ruined; I'm afraid all of today's activities must be rearranged anew.

examples.chinese: 大龍最近買了一套音響，每天回到家就聽他最愛的英國樂團的音樂。
examples.pinyin: Dàlóng zuìjìn mǎi le yī tào yīnxiǎng, měitiān huí dào jiā jiù tīng tā zuì ài de Yīngguó yuètuán de yīnyuè.
examples.english: Dalong recently bought a stereo set; every day when he gets home, he listens to music by his favorite British band.

examples.chinese: 在王小姐的部落格裡，除了有她的旅遊日記，還有在非洲大草原騎馬的相片。
examples.pinyin: Zài Wáng xiǎojiě de bùluògé lǐ, chúle yǒu tā de lǚyóu rìjì, hái yǒu zài Fēizhōu dà cǎoyuán qí mǎ de xiàngpiàn.
examples.english: In Miss Wang's blog, besides her travel diary, there are also photos of horseback riding on the African savanna.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 父母做人做事的態度，對孩子會產生極大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi huì chǎnshēng jí dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents' attitudes toward how they conduct themselves and handle matters will produce a tremendous influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 雲小姐最近突然開始化妝了，人也變美了。大家都猜她戀愛了。
examples.pinyin: Yún xiǎojiě zuìjìn tūrán kāishǐ huàzhuāng le, rén yě biàn měi le. Dàjiā dōu cāi tā liàn'ài le.
examples.english: Miss Yun recently suddenly started wearing makeup, and she has become prettier too. Everyone guesses that she is in love.

examples.chinese: 天空突然下起了大雨，我的衣服和頭髮都濕了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānkōng tūrán xià qǐ le dà yǔ, wǒ de yīfu hé tóufa dōu shī le.
examples.english: Suddenly it started raining heavily, and my clothes and hair all got wet.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的變化很大，不少老房屋已經變成新大樓了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de biànhuà hěn dà, bùshǎo lǎo fángwū yǐjīng biànchéng xīn dàlóu le.
examples.english: This city has changed a lot; many old houses have already turned into new high-rise buildings.

examples.chinese: 秋天的天氣變化很大，早晚都有點涼，出門時最好帶件外套。 這碗魚湯要趁熱喝，涼了就不好喝了。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān de tiānqì biànhuà hěn dà, zǎowǎn dōu yǒudiǎn liáng, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài jiàn wàitào. Zhè wǎn yútāng yào chèn rè hē, liáng le jiù bù hǎohē le.
examples.english: Autumn weather changes a lot; it's a bit chilly morning and evening, so it's best to bring a jacket when going out. This bowl of fish soup should be drunk while hot; once it's cold, it won't taste good.

examples.chinese: 我們爬山爬到一半就起風了，過了幾分鐘就下起大雨來了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen páshān pá dào yíbàn jiù qǐ fēng le, guò le jǐ fēnzhōng jiù xià qǐ dà yǔ lái le.
examples.english: We were halfway up the mountain when the wind started to rise, and a few minutes later it started to rain heavily.

examples.chinese: 孔子不僅是中國偉大教師的代表，他的教育和哲學思想，對華人的影響也很大。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ bùjǐn shì Zhōngguó wěidà jiàoshī de dàibiǎo, tā de jiàoyù hé zhéxué sīxiǎng, duì Huárén de yǐngxiàng yě hěn dà.
examples.english: Confucius is not only a representative of China's great teachers, but his educational and philosophical thoughts have also had a great influence on Chinese people.

examples.chinese: 東西方的文化差異很大，像穿著、音樂、哲學等風格都不相同。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxīfāng de wénhuà chāyì hěn dà, xiàng chuānzhuó, yīnyuè, zhéxué děng fēnggé dōu bù xiāngtóng.
examples.english: The cultural differences between East and West are great; styles such as apparel, music, and philosophy are all different.

examples.chinese: 我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le. A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english: My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding. A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，孔子是地位最高、最偉大的老師，他的思想影響了很多人。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, Kǒngzǐ shì dìwèi zuì gāo, zuì wěidà de lǎoshī, tā de sīxiǎng yǐngxiǎng le hěn duō rén.
examples.english: For Chinese people, Confucius is the teacher with the highest position and the greatest, and his thoughts have influenced many people.

examples.chinese: 這棟商業大樓的規模很大，除了有很多商店、餐廳，還有電影院、健身房。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng shāngyè dàlóu de guīmó hěn dà, chúle yǒu hěn duō shāngdiàn, cāntīng, hái yǒu diànyǐngyuàn, jiànshēnfáng.
examples.english: The scale of this commercial building is very large; besides many shops and restaurants, there are also a movie theater and a gym.

examples.chinese: 有人說發生大地震以前，小動物會亂跑、亂叫，這是很自然的現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō fāshēng dà dìzhèn yǐqián, xiǎo dòngwù huì luàn pǎo, luàn jiào, zhè shì hěn zìrán de xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some people say that before a major earthquake occurs, small animals will run around and make noise; this is a very natural phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de. Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english: True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you. Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 那位老太太年紀大了，沒辦法照顧他的狗，所以想幫狗找個新主人。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎotàitai niánjì dà le, méi bànfǎ zhàogù tā de gǒu, suǒyǐ xiǎng bāng gǒu zhǎo ge xīn zhǔrén.
examples.english: That old lady is advanced in age and has no way to take care of her dog, so she wants to find a new owner for the dog.

examples.chinese: 不少外國人說，臺灣最大的魅力是人們能夠接受不同的文化、語言和想法，所以在臺灣生活非常自在。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō, Táiwān zuì dà de mèilì shì rénmen nénggòu jiēshòu bùtóng de wénhuà, yǔyán hé xiǎngfǎ, suǒyǐ zài Táiwān shēnghuó fēicháng zìzài.
examples.english: Many foreigners say that Taiwan's greatest charm is that people can accept different cultures, languages, and ideas, so living in Taiwan is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 我們公司打算今年跟美國合作，生產名牌皮包。除夕那天，大家都忙著打掃、貼春聯，只有弟弟很不合作，什麼事都不做。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī dǎsuàn jīnnián gēn Měiguó hézuò, shēngchǎn míngpái píbāo. Chúxī nà tiān, dàjiā dōu mángzhe dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, zhǐyǒu dìdi hěn bù hézuò, shénme shì dōu bù zuò.
examples.english: Our company plans to cooperate with the US this year to produce brand-name leather bags. On New Year's Eve, everyone was busy cleaning and putting up spring couplets; only my younger brother was very uncooperative and didn't do anything.

examples.chinese: 這次地震的規模很大，連總統一時也很難掌握各地的災情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, lián zǒngtǒng yīshí yě hěn nán zhǎngwò gèdì de zāiqíng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake was very large; even the president had difficulty grasping the disaster situation in various places for a while.

examples.chinese: 那棟大樓發生火災時，還好安全人員很冷靜，才能帶著大家安全地離開。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng dàlóu fāshēng huǒzāi shí, hái hǎo ānquán rényuán hěn lěngjìng, cái néng dài zhe dàjiā ānquán de líkāi.
examples.english: When that building caught fire, fortunately the safety personnel were very calm, so they were able to lead everyone to leave safely.

examples.chinese: 他畢竟是個小孩子，還不懂做人做事的道理，等他長大就會明白了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìjìng shì ge xiǎoháizi, hái bù dǒng zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, děng tā zhǎngdà jiù huì míngbai le.
examples.english: After all, he is a child and doesn't yet understand the principles of how to conduct himself and do things; when he grows up, he will understand.

examples.chinese: 小戴才三十歲就已經是名牌服裝公司的大老闆，這麼年輕就有這樣的成就，實在不簡單。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài cái sānshí suì jiù yǐjīng shì míngpái fúzhuāng gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn, zhème niánqīng jiù yǒu zhèyàng de chéngjiù, shízài bù jiǎndān.
examples.english: Little Dai is only thirty years old and is already the big boss of a famous brand clothing company; to have such accomplishments at such a young age is really not simple.

examples.chinese: 這次期末考的題目很難，大家的成績都不好，還有幾個人被當了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qīmò kǎo de tímù hěn nán, dàjiā de chéngjì dōu bù hǎo, hái yǒu jǐ ge rén bèi dāng le.
examples.english: The questions on this final exam were very difficult; everyone’s grades were bad, and several people even failed the course.

examples.chinese: 王教授不但知識很豐富，研究成果也受到大家的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu búdàn zhīshi hěn fēngfù, yánjiū chéngguǒ yě shòudào dàjiā de kěndìng.
examples.english: Professor Wang not only has abundant knowledge, but his research results are also recognized by everyone.

examples.chinese: 那所非常有名的大學每年只錄取一千名新生，除了得成績夠好，還需要一點兒運氣才進得去。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ fēicháng yǒumíng de dàxué měi nián zhǐ lùqǔ yīqiān míng xīnshēng, chúle děi chéngjì gòu hǎo, hái xūyào yīdiǎnr yùnqi cái jìn de qù.
examples.english: That very famous university only admits one thousand new students each year; besides needing good enough grades, you also need a bit of luck to get in.

examples.chinese: 市長解決了不少這個城市的生活問題，因此民眾的生活水準也大大提高了。
examples.pinyin: Shìzhǎng jiějué le bùshǎo zhège chéngshì de shēnghuó wèntí, yīncǐ mínzhòng de shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě dàdà tígāo le.
examples.english: The mayor solved quite a few of this city's living problems, therefore the people's standard of living has also greatly improved.

examples.chinese: 陳先生有五個孩子，生活費負擔很大。小張不想增加父親的負擔，為了負擔自己的學費，一下課就去打工。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānsheng yǒu wǔ gè háizi, shēnghuófèi fùdān hěn dà. Xiǎo Zhāng bù xiǎng zēngjiā fùqīn de fùdān, wèile fùdān zìjǐ de xuéfèi, yī xiàkè jiù qù dǎgōng.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has five children, so the burden of living expenses is very great. Little Zhang doesn't want to increase his father's burden; in order to shoulder his own tuition, he goes to work as soon as class is over.

examples.chinese: 我們把考卷交給老師後，老師就把正確的答案告訴大家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bǎ kǎojuàn jiāo gěi lǎoshī hòu, lǎoshī jiù bǎ zhèngquè de dá'àn gàosu dàjiā.
examples.english: After we handed the exam papers to the teacher, the teacher then told everyone the correct answers.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 我爺爺年紀大了，不但體力不好，還有頭痛、肩膀痛的毛病。我家的洗衣機用了二十多年了，毛病真不少，可是媽媽還不肯換新的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye niánjì dà le, bùdàn tǐlì bù hǎo, hái yǒu tóutòng, jiānbǎng tòng de máobìng. Wǒ jiā de xǐyījī yòng le èrshí duō nián le, máobìng zhēn bù shǎo, kěshì māma hái bù kěn huàn xīn de.
examples.english: My grandpa is old; not only is his physical strength poor, but he also has the problem of headaches and shoulder pain. Our washing machine has been used for over twenty years and has quite a few problems, but Mom still won't agree to replace it with a new one.

examples.chinese: 張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le. Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard. Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 大雄從小個性就很被動，別人要求的事他才做，父母跟老師都希望他可以主動一點。
examples.pinyin: Dàxióng cóngxiǎo gèxìng jiù hěn bèidòng, biérén yāoqiú de shì tā cái zuò, fùmǔ gēn lǎoshī dōu xīwàng tā kěyǐ zhǔdòng yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Daxiong has been passive in personality since childhood; he only does things when others ask him to. His parents and teachers all hope he can be a bit more proactive.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風引起的水災太嚴重，害大家一連五天沒有乾淨的水可以用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǐnqǐ de shuǐzāi tài yánzhòng, hài dàjiā yīlián wǔ tiān méiyǒu gānjìng de shuǐ kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: The flood caused by this typhoon was too serious, causing everyone to go five days in a row without clean water to use.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 員工：謝謝您幫了我一個大忙，這個小禮物請您收下。 主管：你太客氣了！這點兒小事真的沒什麼。
examples.pinyin: Yuángōng: Xièxie nín bāng le wǒ yī gè dà máng, zhège xiǎo lǐwù qǐng nín shōuxià. Zhǔguǎn: Nǐ tài kèqì le! Zhè diǎnr xiǎoshì zhēn de méishénme.
examples.english: Employee: Thank you for doing me a big favor; please accept this small gift. Supervisor: You're too polite! This little thing really is nothing serious.

examples.chinese: 小藍從小在育幼院長大，最大的願望就是將來能有一個溫暖的家庭。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lán cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, zuì dà de yuànwàng jiùshì jiānglái néng yǒu yī gè wēnnuǎn de jiātíng.
examples.english: Xiao Lan grew up in an orphanage; her greatest wish is to have a warm family in the future.

examples.chinese: 每個人一輩子都會遇到像沒考上大學、找不到工作那樣的挫折，但只要努力就有希望。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén yībèizi dōu huì yùdào xiàng méi kǎoshàng dàxué, zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò nàyàng de cuòzhé, dàn zhǐyào nǔlì jiù yǒu xīwàng.
examples.english: Everyone will encounter frustrations like not getting into university or not finding a job in their lifetime, but as long as you work hard, there is hope.

examples.chinese: 父母是孩子的榜樣，他們的性格和做人做事的態度，對孩子都有很大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì háizi de bǎngyàng, tāmen de xìnggé hé zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi dōu yǒu hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents are their children's role models; their personality and their attitude toward how to conduct themselves and do things both have a great influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 小高希望能早日退休，回鄉下照顧年紀大的父母。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Gāo xīwàng néng zǎorì tuìxiū, huí xiāngxià zhàogù niánjì dà de fùmǔ.
examples.english: Xiao Gao hopes to retire sooner and return to the countryside to take care of his elderly parents.

examples.chinese: 這場大地震發生後不久，軍人就立刻趕到了災區，協助救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn fāshēng hòu bùjiǔ, jūnrén jiù lìkè gǎndàole zāiqū, xiézhù jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: Shortly after this major earthquake occurred, soldiers immediately rushed to the disaster area to assist with disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué jiàoyù de mùdì, bùjǐn yào tígāo xuéshēng de zhīshì shuǐzhǔn, hái yào jìnyībù péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: The purpose of university education is not only to raise students' level of knowledge but also to further cultivate students' professional abilities.

examples.chinese: 在那場車禍中，那個孩子失去了父母，家裡只剩下他一個人，大家都很同情他。
examples.pinyin: Zài nà chǎng chēhuò zhōng, nàge háizi shīqù le fùmǔ, jiālǐ zhǐ shèng xià tā yī ge rén, dàjiā dōu hěn tóngqíng tā.
examples.english: In that car accident, that child lost his parents, and he was the only one left in the family; everyone sympathized with him.

examples.chinese: 這家電腦公司本來只服務亞洲地區的民眾，現在服務範圍已經擴大到歐洲了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diànnǎo gōngsī běnlái zhǐ fúwù Yàzhōu dìqū de mínzhòng, xiànzài fúwù fànwéi yǐjīng kuòdà dào Ōuzhōu le.
examples.english: This computer company originally only served people in the Asian region, but now its service range has already expanded to Europe.

examples.chinese: 只要照溫老師安排的課程，多閱讀、多練習，你的中文就會有很大的進步。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào zhào Wēn lǎoshī ānpái de kèchéng, duō yuèdú, duō liànxí, nǐ de Zhōngwén jiù huì yǒu hěn dà de jìnbù.
examples.english: As long as you follow the curriculum arranged by Teacher Wen, read more and practice more, your Chinese will make great progress.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 那對雙胞胎長得很像，個性卻很不同，哥哥很大方，弟弟很害羞。
examples.pinyin: Nà duì shuāngbāotāi zhǎng de hěn xiàng, gèxìng què hěn bùtóng, gēge hěn dàfāng, dìdi hěn hàixiū.
examples.english: That pair of twins look very much alike, but their personalities are very different: the older brother is very outgoing, and the younger brother is very shy.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，父母在孩子的心中是最偉大的，沒有人可以取代。
examples.pinyin: Yìbān lái shuō, fùmǔ zài háizi de xīnzhōng shì zuì wěidà de, méiyǒu rén kěyǐ qǔdài.
examples.english: Generally speaking, parents are the greatest in their children's hearts; no one can replace them.

examples.chinese: 弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好。為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi yīnwèi míngtiān yào qù dàxué miànshì, jǐnzhāng de zhěnggè wǎnshang dōu shuì bù hǎo. Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì de miànshì, wǒ kàn le hěnduō xiāngguān zīliào, hái búduàn de liànxí miànshì shí gēn zhǔguǎn de duìhuà.
examples.english: Because my younger brother is going to a university interview tomorrow, he was so nervous that he couldn't sleep well the whole night. In order to prepare for this interview, I read a lot of related information and also constantly practiced the conversation with the manager during the interview.

examples.chinese: 明天的主管會議在三樓的會議室舉行，經理要求大家不要遲到。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de zhǔguǎn huìyì zài sān lóu de huìyìshì jǔxíng, jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā búyào chídào.
examples.english: Tomorrow's supervisor meeting will be held in the meeting room on the third floor; the manager requires everyone not to be late.

examples.chinese: 假如貴公司想擴大生產規模，可以參考本公司的作法，我們很願意提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú guì gōngsī xiǎng kuòdà shēngchǎn guīmó, kěyǐ cānkǎo běn gōngsī de zuòfǎ, wǒmen hěn yuànyì tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: If your honorable company wants to expand production scale, you can refer to our company's methods; we are very willing to provide assistance.

examples.chinese: 大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解。先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù de rén rènwéi zhéxué shì yì mén hěn nán de xuéwèn, bù róngyì lǐjiě. Xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn qíguài, yòu ài luàn fā píqì, chúle tā lǎopó, méi rén néng lǐjiě tā.
examples.english: Most people think philosophy is a very difficult subject to understand. The husband's personality is very strange, and he also loves to lose his temper randomly; except for his wife, no one can understand him.

examples.chinese: 雖然藍先生是大學的校長，可是他很謙虛，經常向同事請教管理學校的方法。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán Lán xiānsheng shì dàxué de xiàozhǎng, kěshì tā hěn qiānxū, jīngcháng xiàng tóngshì qǐngjiào guǎnlǐ xuéxiào de fāngfǎ.
examples.english: Although Mr. Lan is a university president, he is very modest and often asks colleagues for advice on methods for managing the school.

examples.chinese: 不知道明哲今天怎麼了？老師叫了他好幾次，他就像木頭一樣，沒有反應。九二一大地震發生得太突然，不少民眾因為來不及反應，而被困在屋裡。
examples.pinyin: Bù zhīdào Míngzhé jīntiān zěnme le? Lǎoshī jiào le tā hǎojǐ cì, tā jiù xiàng mùtou yíyàng, méiyǒu fǎnyìng. / Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn fāshēng de tài tūrán, bùshǎo mínzhòng yīnwèi láibují fǎnyìng, ér bèi kùn zài wū lǐ.
examples.english: I don't know what's wrong with Mingzhe today? The teacher called him several times, but he was like a piece of wood, without any reaction. / The 921 earthquake happened too suddenly; many people were trapped inside their houses because they didn't have time to react.

examples.chinese: 總統對國家的貢獻很大，全國民眾都很尊敬他。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng duì guójiā de gòngxiàn hěn dà, quánguó mínzhòng dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
examples.english: The president's contribution to the country is great; the people of the whole nation all respect him.

examples.chinese: 李導演付出了十年的時間，終於拍出了一部好電影，得到大家的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ dǎoyǎn fùchū le shí nián de shíjiān, zhōngyú pāichū le yī bù hǎo diànyǐng, dédào dàjiā de kěndìng.
examples.english: Director Li devoted ten years of time and finally made a good movie, receiving everyone's recognition.

examples.chinese: 杜先生是三家網路商店的主管，他希望將來能當大企業的老闆，擁有自己的事業。
examples.pinyin: Dù xiānsheng shì sān jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn de zhǔguǎn, tā xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng dà qǐyè de lǎobǎn, yǒngyǒu zìjǐ de shìyè.
examples.english: Mr. Du is the manager of three online stores; he hopes that in the future he can become the boss of a big enterprise and have his own career.

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese: 小明順利通過了大學考試，今年就是一年級的新生了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shùnlì tōngguò le dàxué kǎoshì, jīnnián jiù shì yī niánjí de xīnshēng le.
examples.english: Xiaoming successfully passed the university exam; this year he is a freshman.

examples.chinese: 那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi. Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english: The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically. This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 那個外國人第一次來臺灣就碰上了大地震，讓他非常難忘。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wàiguó rén dì yī cì lái Táiwān jiù pèng shàng le dà dìzhèn, ràng tā fēicháng nánwàng.
examples.english: That foreigner encountered a major earthquake on his first visit to Taiwan, which made it very unforgettable for him.

examples.chinese: 外面風大雨大，媽媽只好把還沒乾的衣服收進來，掛在屋內。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēng dà yǔ dà, māma zhǐhǎo bǎ hái méi gān de yīfu shōu jìnlái, guà zài wū nèi.
examples.english: Outside the wind and rain were strong, so Mom had no choice but to bring in the clothes that were not yet dry and hang them inside the house.

examples.chinese: 前天的強烈颱風帶來了大雨，很多地方都淹水了。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān de qiángliè táifēng dài lái le dàyǔ, hěn duō dìfāng dōu yānshuǐ le.
examples.english: The strong typhoon the day before yesterday brought heavy rain, and many places were flooded.

examples.chinese: A:公司從明天起就不再提供免費的三餐了。 B:這麼重大的決定，為什麼現在才通知我們？
examples.pinyin: A: Gōngsī cóng míngtiān qǐ jiù bù zài tígōng miǎnfèi de sān cān le. B: Zhème zhòngdà de juédìng, wèishénme xiànzài cái tōngzhī wǒmen?
examples.english: A: Starting tomorrow, the company will no longer provide free three meals. B: Such a major decision—why are we only being notified now?

examples.chinese: 老闆為了感謝員工為公司付出這麼多，決定親手做菜請大家吃。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn wèile gǎnxiè yuángōng wèi gōngsī fùchū zhème duō, juédìng qīnshǒu zuò cài qǐng dàjiā chī.
examples.english: To thank the employees for contributing so much to the company, the boss decided to personally cook a meal and invite everyone to eat.

examples.chinese: 站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了。「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhàn zài lǎobǎn bèihòu de nàge rén yǐjīng tōngguò le miànshì, míngtiān jiù yào lái shàngbān le. 2. Měi ge chénggōng nánrén de bèihòu, dōu yǒu yí ge wěidà de nǚrén. Nǐ juéde zhè jù huà yǒu dàolǐ ma?
examples.english: 1. The person standing behind the boss has already passed the interview and will come to work tomorrow. 2. Behind every successful man, there is a great woman. Do you think this saying makes sense?

examples.chinese: 跟大人比起來，小孩子的想法比較單純、天真，不會故意騙人。A:網友跟我借十萬塊錢，說他的家人生病住院了。 B:你太天真了，他是騙你的。
examples.pinyin: 1. Gēn dàrén bǐ qǐlái, xiǎoháizi de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào dānchún, tiānzhēn, bú huì gùyì piàn rén. 2. A: Wǎngyǒu gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài qián, shuō tā de jiārén shēngbìng zhùyuàn le. B: Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le, tā shì piàn nǐ de.
examples.english: 1. Compared with adults, children's thinking is simpler and more innocent; they won't deliberately deceive people. 2. A: An online friend borrowed a hundred thousand dollars from me, saying his family member was sick and hospitalized. B: You're too naive; he's deceiving you.

examples.chinese: 媽媽實在太會做飯了，只用了一個小時就變出一桌既豐富又好吃的大餐。
examples.pinyin: Māma shízài tài huì zuòfàn le, zhǐ yòng le yí ge xiǎoshí jiù biàn chū yì zhuō jì fēngfù yòu hǎochī de dàcān.
examples.english: Mom is really too good at cooking; in just one hour, she conjured up a table full of both abundant and delicious feast.

examples.chinese: 他努力了三年，終於考上了最好的大學，他激動得流下了眼淚。
examples.pinyin: Tā nǔlì le sān nián, zhōngyú kǎoshàng le zuì hǎo de dàxué, tā jīdòng de liú xià le yǎnlèi.
examples.english: He worked hard for three years and finally got into the best university; he was so excited that he shed tears.

examples.chinese: 中秋節是華人團圓的日子，除了吃月餅、欣賞月亮，還會一起烤肉。小文從小在育幼院長大，到了二十歲才找到叔叔，跟家人團圓了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngqiūjié shì Huárén tuányuán de rìzi, chúle chī yuèbǐng, xīnshǎng yuèliang, hái huì yìqǐ kǎoròu. Xiǎowén cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, dào le èrshí suì cái zhǎodào shūshu, gēn jiārén tuányuán le.
examples.english: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for Chinese people to have family reunion. Besides eating mooncakes and admiring the moon, they also have a barbecue together. Xiaowen grew up in an orphanage from a young age, and only at the age of twenty did he find his uncle and have a reunion with his family.

examples.chinese: 母親為家人親手織了幾件毛衣，希望讓大家過個溫暖的冬天。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīn wèi jiārén qīnshǒu zhī le jǐ jiàn máoyī, xīwàng ràng dàjiā guò ge wēnnuǎn de dōngtiān.
examples.english: Mother personally knitted several sweaters for the family, hoping to let everyone have a warm winter.

examples.chinese: 易先生對戲劇有很大的興趣，小時候的夢想就是當一名成功的演員。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng duì xìjù yǒu hěn dà de xìngqù, xiǎoshíhou de mèngxiǎng jiùshì dāng yì míng chénggōng de yǎnyuán.
examples.english: Mr. Yi has a great interest in drama; his childhood dream was to become a successful actor.

examples.chinese: 這座城市不但交通十分便利，生活水準也很高，大家都想搬來這裡住。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì bùdàn jiāotōng shífēn biànlì, shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě hěn gāo, dàjiā dōu xiǎng bān lái zhèlǐ zhù.
examples.english: Not only is transportation in this city extremely convenient, but the standard of living is also very high; everyone wants to move here to live.

examples.chinese: 一大早就有不少民眾在寺廟前的廣場上運動。
examples.pinyin: Yī dàzǎo jiù yǒu bùshǎo mínzhòng zài sìmiào qián de guǎngchǎng shàng yùndòng.
examples.english: Early in the morning, quite a few people are already exercising in the square in front of the temple.

examples.chinese: 那棟公寓自從三年前的一場大火之後，就不適合居住了。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng gōngyù zìcóng sān nián qián de yī chǎng dàhuǒ zhīhòu, jiù bù shìhé jūzhù le.
examples.english: Since a big fire three years ago, that apartment building has not been suitable for residing in.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: 絕大部分的華人都很重視春節，所以回家團圓、互相拜年，他們認為都是該做的。
examples.pinyin: Jué dà bùfèn de Huárén dōu hěn zhòngshì Chūnjié, suǒyǐ huíjiā tuányuán, hùxiāng bàinián, tāmen rènwéi dōu shì gāi zuò de.
examples.english: The vast majority of Chinese people value the Spring Festival highly, so they believe that going home for family reunions and exchanging New Year greetings are things that should be done.

examples.chinese: 這課的漢字我都認得，但還不太會寫，所以筆試時好些字都寫錯了。弟弟：爺爺怎麼常把我和你的名字搞錯？ 哥哥：爺爺年紀太大了，腦子不清楚，好像不認得我們了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kè de Hànzì wǒ dōu rènde, dàn hái bù tài huì xiě, suǒyǐ bǐshì shí hǎoxiē zì dōu xiě cuò le. Dìdi: Yéye zěnme cháng bǎ wǒ hé nǐ de míngzi gǎo cuò? Gēge: Yéye niánjì tài dà le, nǎozi bù qīngchu, hǎoxiàng bù rènde wǒmen le.
examples.english: I can recognize all the Chinese characters in this lesson, but I am not yet able to write them well, so I wrote many characters incorrectly on the written test. Younger brother: Why does Grandpa often mix up your name and mine? Older brother: Grandpa is too old and his mind is unclear; it seems he no longer recognizes us.

examples.chinese: 小安有一張娃娃臉，到哪裡都被當作大學生，誰知道他已經四十歲了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo'ān yǒu yì zhāng wáwa liǎn, dào nǎlǐ dōu bèi dàngzuò dàxuéshēng, shéi zhīdào tā yǐjīng sìshí suì le.
examples.english: Xiao An has a baby face, so wherever he goes he is treated as a university student; who would know he is already forty years old.

examples.chinese: 根據專家的說法，想要身體健康，一天至少得喝五大杯水。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù zhuānjiā de shuōfǎ, xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, yì tiān zhìshǎo děi hē wǔ dà bēi shuǐ.
examples.english: According to experts, if you want to be healthy, you need to drink at least five large glasses of water a day.

examples.chinese: 最近天氣不太穩定，氣溫的變化很大，出門時最好帶把傘。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì bú tài wěndìng, qìwēn de biànhuà hěn dà, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài bǎ sǎn.
examples.english: The weather has been unstable recently, and the temperature changes a lot; when going out, it's best to bring an umbrella.

examples.chinese: 昨天棒球賽進行到一半時突然下起了大雨，雖然後來雨停了，但因為球場太溼，也無法繼續比賽了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān bàngqiúsài jìnxíng dào yíbàn shí tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, suīrán hòulái yǔ tíng le, dàn yīnwèi qiúchǎng tài shī, yě wúfǎ jìxù bǐsài le.
examples.english: Yesterday, when the baseball game had proceeded to halfway, it suddenly started raining heavily. Although the rain stopped later, because the field was too wet, the game could not continue.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 這條路不平，有民眾貼了海報，請大家走路時要小心，以免受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù bù píng, yǒu mínzhòng tiē le hǎibào, qǐng dàjiā zǒulù shí yào xiǎoxīn, yǐmiǎn shòushāng.
examples.english: This road is uneven, and some people have put up posters asking everyone to be careful when walking, in order to avoid getting hurt.

examples.chinese: 王伯伯最近很得意，到處告訴鄰居他兒子考上了全國最有名的大學。
examples.pinyin: Wáng bóbo zuìjìn hěn déyì, dàochù gàosù línjū tā érzi kǎo shàng le quánguó zuì yǒumíng de dàxué.
examples.english: Uncle Wang has been very proud of himself recently, telling neighbors everywhere that his son has been admitted to the most famous university in the country.

examples.chinese: 王先生投資生意的眼光很好，讓他僅僅一年就買下了好幾棟大樓。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng tóuzī shēngyì de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, ràng tā jǐnjǐn yī nián jiù mǎi xià le hǎo jǐ dòng dàlóu.
examples.english: Mr. Wang's eye for investing in business is very good; it made him buy several buildings in just one year.

examples.chinese: 由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yúnduān kējì de jìnbù, rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì gēn yǐwǎng bǐ qǐlái yǒu hěn dà de chāyì.
examples.english: Owing to advances in cloud technology, humans' way of life has great differences compared to the past.

examples.chinese: 大信覺得這個公司的薪水跟福利都不好，於是決定換工作。
examples.pinyin: Dàxìn juéde zhège gōngsī de xīnshuǐ gēn fúlì dōu bù hǎo, yúshì juédìng huàn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Daxin felt that this company's salary and benefits were both bad, so he decided to change jobs.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 大家都知道喝太多酒對身體沒有好處，但不少人仍然如此，甚至天天喝醉。淡水的夕陽很美，如此的美麗風景，是約會的極佳地點。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zhīdào hē tài duō jiǔ duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù, dàn bùshǎo rén réngrán rúcǐ, shènzhì tiāntiān hē zuì. Dànshuǐ de xīyáng hěn měi, rúcǐ de měilì fēngjǐng, shì yuēhuì de jíjiā dìdiǎn.
examples.english: Everyone knows that drinking too much alcohol is not good for the body, but many people still do so, and even get drunk every day. The sunset in Tamsui is very beautiful; such a beautiful scenery is an excellent place for a date.

examples.chinese: 友美，妳看，天美飯店在大學路。我現在知道怎麼走了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ kàn, Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài Dàxué Lù. Wǒ xiànzài zhīdào zěnme zǒu le.
examples.english: Look, Youmei. Tianmei Hotel is on Daxue Road. Now I know how to get there.

examples.chinese: 期中考快要到了，老師說我們可以去圖書館對面的大教室看書。
examples.pinyin: Qízhōngkǎo kuàiyào dào le, lǎoshī shuō wǒmen kěyǐ qù túshūguǎn duìmiàn de dà jiàoshì kànshū.
examples.english: The midterm exam is coming soon. The teacher said we could use the big classroom across from the library for studying.

examples.chinese: 我去年去看了，很多大人帶著小孩去看燈會，非常熱鬧，我照了很多相片。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qùnián qù kàn le, hěn duō dàrén dài zhe xiǎohái qù kàn dēnghuì, fēicháng rènào, wǒ zhào le hěn duō xiàngpiàn.
examples.english: Last year I went to see the Carnival. Many adults brought their children to see the Lantern Carnival, and it was very lively. I took a lot of photos.

items.wordHook: Arms stretched as a 一(one) bar, a 人(person) looks huge: 大(big).

examples.chinese: 後天是我朋友的生日，我想送他一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hòutiān shì wǒ péngyǒu de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow is my friend’s birthday; I want to give him a big cake.

examples.chinese: 後天是我朋友的生日，我想要送他一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hòutiān shì wǒ péngyǒu de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng yào sòng tā yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow is my friend's birthday; I want to give him a big cake.

examples.chinese: 後天去呢？
examples.pinyin: Hòutiān qù ne?
examples.english: How about the day after tomorrow then?

examples.chinese: 我後天要到這家飯店去看朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hòutiān yào dào zhè jiā fàndiàn qù kàn péngyǒu.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow I am going to this hotel to see a friend.

examples.chinese: 那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào. Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english: That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me. I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

examples.chinese: 這件事情，他已經告訴大家了。我今天做了很多事，現在累了，需要休息了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng, tā yǐjīng gàosu dàjiā le. Wǒ jīntiān zuò le hěn duō shì, xiànzài lèi le, xūyào xiūxí le.
examples.english: This matter, he has already told everyone. Today I did many things; now I am tired and need to rest.

examples.chinese: 這件事情他自己可以做，不需要我們幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng tā zìjǐ kěyǐ zuò, bù xūyào wǒmen bāngmáng.
examples.english: He can do this matter himself; he doesn't need our help.

examples.chinese: 下班以後，我常跟同事一起去吃晚飯。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, wǒ cháng gēn tóngshì yìqǐ qù chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: After getting off work, I often go to eat dinner with colleagues.

examples.chinese: 他在跟家人談事情，已經講了三十分鐘的話了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gēn jiārén tán shìqíng, yǐjīng jiǎngle sānshí fēnzhōng de huà le.
examples.english: He is discussing something with his family; he has already been talking for thirty minutes.

examples.chinese: 下課以後，我要跟同學討論去日月潭旅行的事情。
examples.pinyin: Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ yào gēn tóngxué tǎolùn qù Rìyuètán lǚxíng de shìqing.
examples.english: After class, I want to discuss the trip to Sun Moon Lake with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 搬家是一件很麻煩的事情。
examples.pinyin: Bānjiā shì yí jiàn hěn máfan de shìqing.
examples.english: Moving house is a very troublesome thing.

examples.chinese: 別逼孩子做他們沒興趣或是不喜歡的事情。
examples.pinyin: Bié bī háizi zuò tāmen méi xìngqù huòshì bù xǐhuān de shìqíng.
examples.english: Don't force children to do things they're not interested in or don't like.

examples.chinese: 在追求夢想的路上，會遇到很困難的事情，只有不斷努力，才能完成夢想。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang, huì yùdào hěn kùnnan de shìqing, zhǐyǒu bùduàn nǔlì, cái néng wánchéng mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, you will encounter very difficult things; only by making continuous efforts can you fulfill your dreams.

examples.chinese: 「了」這個詞的用法可以代表事情完成或情況改變。
examples.pinyin: 「le」 zhège cí de yòngfǎ kěyǐ dàibiǎo shìqíng wánchéng huò qíngkuàng gǎibiàn.
examples.english: The usage of the word 'le' can represent the completion of an action or a change in situation.

examples.chinese: 對連電腦都不知道怎麼打開的人來說，上網購物是一件非常困難的事情。
examples.pinyin: Duì lián diànnǎo dōu bù zhīdào zěnme dǎkāi de rén lái shuō, shàngwǎng gòuwù shì yī jiàn fēicháng kùnnán de shìqíng.
examples.english: For people who don't even know how to turn on a computer, shopping online is a very difficult thing.

examples.chinese: 張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le. Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard. Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 小馬做事又負責又認真，答應別人的事情也一定會做到，是個很可靠的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ zuòshì yòu fùzé yòu rènzhēn, dāying biérén de shìqíng yě yīdìng huì zuòdào, shì gè hěn kěkào de rén.
examples.english: Xiao Ma is both responsible and serious in doing things, and he will definitely do what he promises others; he is a very reliable person.

examples.chinese: 由於每個人看事情的角度不同，所以得溝通才能避免誤會。那個模特兒個子高、長得美，從什麼角度拍都漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú měi gè rén kàn shìqíng de jiǎodù bùtóng, suǒyǐ děi gōutōng cái néng bìmiǎn wùhuì. Nàge mótè'ér gèzi gāo, zhǎng de měi, cóng shénme jiǎodù pāi dōu piàoliang.
examples.english: Because each person's point of view on things is different, communication is necessary to avoid misunderstandings. That model is tall and beautiful; from whatever angle you photograph her, she looks pretty.

examples.chinese: 在國外遇見好久沒聯絡的好友，是一件很開心的事情。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài yùjiàn hǎojiǔ méi liánluò de hǎoyǒu, shì yī jiàn hěn kāixīn de shìqing.
examples.english: Meeting a good friend you haven't contacted for a long time abroad is a very happy thing.

examples.chinese: 我們約好下星期一在線上開會，討論辦員工運動會的事情。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuēhǎo xià xīngqīyī zài xiànshàng kāihuì, tǎolùn bàn yuángōng yùndònghuì de shìqing.
examples.english: We agreed to hold a meeting online next Monday to discuss the matter of organizing the employees' sports meet.

examples.chinese: 你要大膽一點兒，不喜歡的事情就拒絕。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào dàdǎn yìdiǎnr, bù xǐhuan de shìqing jiù jùjué.
examples.english: You need to be a bit more bold—if you don't like something, just refuse it.

examples.chinese: 現在的手機都具有語音轉成文字的功能，用來記錄事情非常便利。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de shǒujī dōu jùyǒu yǔyīn zhuǎn chéng wénzì de gōngnéng, yòng lái jìlù shìqíng fēicháng biànlì.
examples.english: Today's mobile phones all have the function of converting voice into text, which is very convenient for recording things.

examples.chinese: 現代社會資訊很發達，一發生重要事情，立刻就上電視、上報了。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài shèhuì zīxùn hěn fādá, yī fāshēng zhòngyào shìqíng, lìkè jiù shàng diànshì, shàng bào le.
examples.english: In modern society, information is very developed; as soon as an important event happens, it immediately appears on TV and in the newspapers.

examples.chinese: 有些事情光是勤勞沒有用，得用對方法才行。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shìqíng guāng shì qínláo méiyǒu yòng, děi yòng duì fāngfǎ cái xíng.
examples.english: For some things, just being hardworking is not useful; you have to use the right method.

examples.chinese: 接觸陌生的事情及環境時，往往令人有點兒不安，這樣的感覺是很自然的。
examples.pinyin: Jiēchù mòshēng de shìqíng jí huánjìng shí, wǎngwǎng lìng rén yǒudiǎnr bù'ān, zhèyàng de gǎnjué shì hěn zìrán de.
examples.english: When coming into contact with unfamiliar things and environments, people often feel a bit uneasy; this feeling is very natural.

examples.chinese: 錯誤通常來自粗心，因此無論事情大小都該用心處理。
examples.pinyin: Cuòwù tōngcháng láizì cūxīn, yīncǐ wúlùn shìqíng dàxiǎo dōu gāi yòngxīn chǔlǐ.
examples.english: Mistakes usually come from carelessness, so no matter how big or small the matter is, it should be handled with care.

examples.chinese: 我看過很多有趣的歷史故事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kàn guo hěn duō yǒuqù de lìshǐ gùshi.
examples.english: I have read many interesting historical stories.

examples.chinese: 明天我要跟朋友去參加跨年活動，我還沒跟父母講這件事。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào gēn péngyǒu qù cānjiā kuànián huódòng, wǒ hái méi gēn fùmǔ jiǎng zhè jiàn shì.
examples.english: Tomorrow I'm going with friends to attend a New Year's Eve event; I still haven't talked to my parents about this.

examples.chinese: 我同事說那家店的麵包很好吃，大人、小孩都喜歡，很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì shuō nà jiā diàn de miànbāo hěn hǎochī, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xǐhuān, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: My colleague says that bakery's bread is very delicious; both adults and children like it—it's very popular.

examples.chinese: 晚上我有事，要出去一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒ yǒu shì, yào chūqù yīxià.
examples.english: I have something to do tonight; I need to go out for a bit.

examples.chinese: 在你家，誰做家事？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ jiā, shéi zuò jiāshì?
examples.english: In your family, who does the housework?

examples.chinese: 暑假的時候，我跟弟弟一起做家事。我掃地，他洗碗筷。
examples.pinyin: Shǔjià de shíhou, wǒ gēn dìdi yīqǐ zuò jiāshì. Wǒ sǎo dì, tā xǐ wǎnkuài.
examples.english: During summer vacation, I do housework together with my younger brother. I sweep the floor, and he washes the dishes.

examples.chinese: 我父母這個週末都不在家，家裡只剩下我一個人。我已經把衣服洗完了，剩下的家事請你做。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùmǔ zhège zhōumò dōu bù zài jiā, jiālǐ zhǐ shèngxià wǒ yī ge rén. Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ yīfu xǐ wán le, shèngxià de jiāshì qǐng nǐ zuò.
examples.english: My parents are both not at home this weekend; only I am left at home. I have already finished washing the clothes; please do the remaining housework.

examples.chinese: 那個學生已經一個星期沒來上課了，他發生了什麼事？
examples.pinyin: Nàge xuéshēng yǐjīng yī gè xīngqī méi lái shàngkè le, tā fāshēngle shénme shì?
examples.english: That student hasn't come to class for a week already; what happened to him?

examples.chinese: 我剛去工作的時候，常常需要同事的幫助。幫助別人讓我覺得很快樂！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng qù gōngzuò de shíhou, chángcháng xūyào tóngshì de bāngzhù. Bāngzhù biérén ràng wǒ juéde hěn kuàilè!
examples.english: When I first started working, I often needed my colleagues' help. Helping others makes me feel very happy!

examples.chinese: 同事都走了，只剩下他一個人還在做事。他是廣告公司的經理，每天要做好多事，忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Tóngshì dōu zǒu le, zhǐ shèngxià tā yí ge rén hái zài zuòshì. Tā shì guǎnggào gōngsī de jīnglǐ, měitiān yào zuò hǎo duō shì, máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: The colleagues have all left; only he is left still working. He is a manager at an advertising company; every day he has to do a lot of work and is incredibly busy.

examples.chinese: 我答應朋友去KTV幫他過生日，沒想到當天我太忙，忘了這件事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dāyìng péngyou qù KTV bāng tā guò shēngrì, méi xiǎngdào dāngtiān wǒ tài máng, wàng le zhè jiàn shì.
examples.english: I promised my friend to go to KTV to celebrate his birthday, but I didn't expect that I would be too busy that day and forgot about this matter.

examples.chinese: 我很餓，同事把他的薯條分一半給我，讓我好感動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn è, tóngshì bǎ tā de shǔtiáo fēn yí bàn gěi wǒ, ràng wǒ hǎo gǎndòng.
examples.english: I was very hungry, and my colleague shared half of his fries with me, which really moved me.

examples.chinese: 我在車站遇到以前的同事，他現在是一家保險公司的經理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài chēzhàn yùdào yǐqián de tóngshì, tā xiànzài shì yì jiā bǎoxiǎn gōngsī de jīnglǐ.
examples.english: I ran into a former colleague at the station; he is now a manager at an insurance company.

examples.chinese: 父母應該好好地教育孩子，讓他們明白做人、做事的道理。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo de jiàoyù háizi, ràng tāmen míngbai zuòrén, zuòshì de dàolǐ.
examples.english: Parents should educate their children well, so that they understand the principles of conducting oneself and doing things.

examples.chinese: 那個明星演戲前都會先研究戲裡的人物、故事，最後才決定表演的方式。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng yǎnxì qián dōu huì xiān yánjiū xì lǐ de rénwù, gùshì, zuìhòu cái juédìng biǎoyǎn de fāngshì.
examples.english: Before that star acts in a drama, he always first studies the characters and story in the play, and only then decides on the way to perform.

examples.chinese: 東賢演什麼像什麼，每部戲都演得非常好，觀眾對他的表現非常肯定。我的新同事不但工作能力強， 也很負責，來公司沒多久就得到經理的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxián yǎn shénme xiàng shénme, měi bù xì dōu yǎn de fēicháng hǎo, guānzhòng duì tā de biǎoxiàn fēicháng kěndìng. Wǒ de xīn tóngshì bùdàn gōngzuò nénglì qiáng, yě hěn fùzé, lái gōngsī méi duōjiǔ jiù dédào jīnglǐ de kěndìng.
examples.english: Dongxian acts whatever role and becomes it; he performs very well in every drama, and the audience highly approves of his performance. My new colleague not only has strong work ability but is also very responsible; not long after coming to the company, he gained the manager's approval.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 為了參加同事的婚禮，我打算當天穿上很有特色的中國傳統服裝。
examples.pinyin: Wèile cānjiā tóngshì de hūnlǐ, wǒ dǎsuàn dāngtiān chuān shàng hěn yǒu tèsè de Zhōngguó chuántǒng fúzhuāng.
examples.english: In order to attend my colleague's wedding, I plan to wear very distinctive traditional Chinese clothing on that day.

examples.chinese: 那位大明星身上穿的、手上戴的 ，都是有名的牌子。經理做事態度認真、負責，我從他身上學到了很多做人做事的道理。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi dà míngxīng shēnshang chuān de, shǒushang dài de, dōu shì yǒumíng de páizi. Jīnglǐ zuòshì tàidù rènzhēn, fùzé, wǒ cóng tā shēnshang xué dào le hěn duō zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ.
examples.english: What that big star wears on her body and on her hands are all famous brands. The manager's work attitude is serious and responsible; I have learned many principles of how to conduct myself and do things from him.

examples.chinese: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 小藍看起來糊里糊塗的，其實做起事來仔細得很。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolán kàn qǐlái húlǐhútú de, qíshí zuò qǐ shì lái zǐxì de hěn.
examples.english: Xiaolan looks muddle-headed, but actually she is very careful when doing things.

examples.chinese: 華人喜歡像二、六、八的數字，這幾個數字都是雙數，有很多好事一起來的意思。
examples.pinyin: Huárén xǐhuān xiàng èr, liù, bā de shùzì, zhè jǐ ge shùzì dōu shì shuāngshù, yǒu hěn duō hǎoshì yìqǐ lái de yìsi.
examples.english: Chinese people like numbers like two, six, and eight; these numbers are all even numbers, which means many good things come together.

examples.chinese: 就要開會了，可是我同事還沒把新產品的說明資料準備好，真叫人緊張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù yào kāihuì le, kěshì wǒ tóngshì hái méi bǎ xīn chǎnpǐn de shuōmíng zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, zhēn jiào rén jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The meeting is about to start, but my colleague still hasn't prepared the explanatory materials for the new product, which really makes one nervous.

examples.chinese: 我的錢包丟了，裡面有護照、 信用卡，這件事很要緊，得馬上告訴警察。A:你怎麼一直咳嗽？要不要去看醫生？ B:不要緊，我吃過藥了，休息一下就好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, lǐmiàn yǒu hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, zhè jiàn shì hěn yàojǐn, děi mǎshàng gàosu jǐngchá. A: Nǐ zěnme yīzhí késòu? Yào bùyào qù kàn yīshēng? B: Bù yàojǐn, wǒ chī guò yào le, xiūxi yīxià jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: I lost my wallet; inside were my passport and credit card. This matter is very important; I must tell the police immediately. A: Why do you keep coughing? Do you want to see a doctor? B: It's not important; I've taken medicine, and I'll be fine after a little rest.

examples.chinese: 我去參加朋友的婚禮，除了送紅包，還祝福他們事事如意、早生貴子、永遠幸福。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù cānjiā péngyou de hūnlǐ, chúle sòng hóngbāo, hái zhùfú tāmen shìshì rúyì, zǎo shēng guìzǐ, yǒngyuǎn xìngfú.
examples.english: I went to attend a friend's wedding; besides giving a red envelope, I also wished them that everything goes as they wish, that they soon have a child, and that they be happy forever.

examples.chinese: 孔先生很重視生活品質，也很喜歡做家事，所以總是把家裡整理得乾乾淨淨的。
examples.pinyin: Kǒng xiānshēng hěn zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí, yě hěn xǐhuān zuò jiāshì, suǒyǐ zǒngshì bǎ jiālǐ zhěnglǐ de gāngānjìngjìng de.
examples.english: Mr. Kong values quality of life very much and also likes doing housework, so he always organizes his home until it is clean and tidy.

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，人們喜歡在屋子外面吹著風、喝著茶，聊聊有趣的事。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, rénmen xǐhuān zài wūzi wàimiàn chuī zhe fēng, hē zhe chá, liáoliao yǒuqù de shì.
examples.english: On summer nights, people like to be outside the house, feeling the breeze, drinking tea, and chatting about interesting things.

examples.chinese: 父母做人做事的態度，對孩子會產生極大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi huì chǎnshēng jí dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents' attitudes toward how they conduct themselves and handle matters will produce a tremendous influence on their children.

examples.chinese: A:怎麼回事？外面怎麼這麼吵？ B:鄰居在修理屋頂，快修理好了，你忍耐一下吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Zěnme huí shì? Wàimiàn zěnme zhème chǎo? B: Línjū zài xiūlǐ wūdǐng, kuài xiūlǐ hǎo le, nǐ rěnnài yīxià ba.
examples.english: A: What's the matter? Why is it so noisy outside? B: The neighbor is repairing the roof; it will be fixed soon, so please put up with it for a bit.

examples.chinese: 就我對小林的了解，他是一個很實在的人，不但做事認真，說話也不誇張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù wǒ duì Xiǎo Lín de liǎojiě, tā shì yīgè hěn shízài de rén, bùdàn zuòshì rènzhēn, shuōhuà yě bù kuāzhāng.
examples.english: With regard to my understanding of Xiao Lin, he is a very honest person; not only does he work seriously, but he also doesn't exaggerate when he speaks.

examples.chinese: 今天藝術系的學生要在學校的禮堂，演出跟十二生肖有關的故事。 那名演員很厲害，在那部電影裡一個人演出三個角色。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yìshù xì de xuéshēng yào zài xuéxiào de lǐtáng, yǎnchū gēn shí'èr shēngxiào yǒuguān de gùshì. Nà míng yǎnyuán hěn lìhài, zài nà bù diànyǐng lǐ yīgè rén yǎnchū sān gè juésè.
examples.english: Today the art department students are going to perform a story related to the twelve zodiac signs in the school auditorium. That actor is very impressive; in that movie, he performed three roles by himself.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 我們公司打算今年跟美國合作，生產名牌皮包。除夕那天，大家都忙著打掃、貼春聯，只有弟弟很不合作，什麼事都不做。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī dǎsuàn jīnnián gēn Měiguó hézuò, shēngchǎn míngpái píbāo. Chúxī nà tiān, dàjiā dōu mángzhe dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, zhǐyǒu dìdi hěn bù hézuò, shénme shì dōu bù zuò.
examples.english: Our company plans to cooperate with the US this year to produce brand-name leather bags. On New Year's Eve, everyone was busy cleaning and putting up spring couplets; only my younger brother was very uncooperative and didn't do anything.

examples.chinese: 小陳認為頭痛是小事，況且最近忙得連休息的時間都不夠，所以不肯去看病。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Chén rènwéi tóutòng shì xiǎoshì, kuàngqiě zuìjìn máng de lián xiūxi de shíjiān dōu bù gòu, suǒyǐ bù kěn qù kànbìng.
examples.english: Xiǎo Chén thinks a headache is a small matter; furthermore, recently he has been so busy that he doesn't even have enough time to rest, so he refuses to see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 他畢竟是個小孩子，還不懂做人做事的道理，等他長大就會明白了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìjìng shì ge xiǎoháizi, hái bù dǒng zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, děng tā zhǎngdà jiù huì míngbai le.
examples.english: After all, he is a child and doesn't yet understand the principles of how to conduct himself and do things; when he grows up, he will understand.

examples.chinese: 他做事的態度很差，而且一不高興就罵人，誰受得了這種人啊！
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì de tàidù hěn chà, érqiě yí bù gāoxìng jiù mà rén, shéi shòu de liǎo zhè zhǒng rén a!
examples.english: His attitude toward work is very bad, and whenever he is unhappy he scolds people; who can tolerate this kind of person!

examples.chinese: 父母除了教導孩子做人做事的道理，也應該肯定他們的表現，讓他們更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ chúle jiàodǎo háizi zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, yě yīnggāi kěndìng tāmen de biǎoxiàn, ràng tāmen gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Besides teaching children the principles of how to conduct themselves and do things, parents should also affirm their performance so that they have more confidence.

examples.chinese: 如果你想了解臺灣社會的人、事、物，最好親自來臺灣住一段時間。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng liǎojiě Táiwān shèhuì de rén, shì, wù, zuìhǎo qīnzì lái Táiwān zhù yí duàn shíjiān.
examples.english: If you want to understand the people, events, and things of Taiwanese society, it is best to come to Taiwan yourself and stay for a period of time.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的想法很不實際，他一直想找一份錢多、事少、離家近的工作，但這種工作很難找啊！
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xiǎngfǎ hěn bù shíjì, tā yīzhí xiǎng zhǎo yī fèn qián duō, shì shǎo, lí jiā jìn de gōngzuò, dàn zhè zhǒng gōngzuò hěn nán zhǎo a!
examples.english: My older brother's way of thinking is very impractical; he keeps wanting to find a job with lots of money, little work, and close to home, but that kind of job is hard to find!

examples.chinese: 大雄從小個性就很被動，別人要求的事他才做，父母跟老師都希望他可以主動一點。
examples.pinyin: Dàxióng cóngxiǎo gèxìng jiù hěn bèidòng, biérén yāoqiú de shì tā cái zuò, fùmǔ gēn lǎoshī dōu xīwàng tā kěyǐ zhǔdòng yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Daxiong has been passive in personality since childhood; he only does things when others ask him to. His parents and teachers all hope he can be a bit more proactive.

examples.chinese: 員工：謝謝您幫了我一個大忙，這個小禮物請您收下。 主管：你太客氣了！這點兒小事真的沒什麼。
examples.pinyin: Yuángōng: Xièxie nín bāng le wǒ yī gè dà máng, zhège xiǎo lǐwù qǐng nín shōuxià. Zhǔguǎn: Nǐ tài kèqì le! Zhè diǎnr xiǎoshì zhēn de méishénme.
examples.english: Employee: Thank you for doing me a big favor; please accept this small gift. Supervisor: You're too polite! This little thing really is nothing serious.

examples.chinese: 父母是孩子的榜樣，他們的性格和做人做事的態度，對孩子都有很大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì háizi de bǎngyàng, tāmen de xìnggé hé zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi dōu yǒu hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents are their children's role models; their personality and their attitude toward how to conduct themselves and do things both have a great influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 金先生最近遇到了很不幸的事，他的父母在一場交通意外中去世了。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiānsheng zuìjìn yùdàole hěn búxìng de shì, tā de fùmǔ zài yì chǎng jiāotōng yìwài zhōng qùshì le.
examples.english: Mr. Jin recently encountered a very unfortunate event: his parents died in a traffic accident.

examples.chinese: 他是一個誠實的孩子，做錯事一定會勇敢承認的。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yī ge chéngshí de háizi, zuò cuò shì yīdìng huì yǒnggǎn chéngrèn de.
examples.english: He is an honest child; if he does something wrong, he will definitely bravely admit it.

examples.chinese: 這部電影是用真實故事拍成的，讓觀眾感覺很真實，也很感動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shì yòng zhēnshí gùshì pāi chéng de, ràng guānzhòng gǎnjué hěn zhēnshí, yě hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: This movie was made based on a real story, making the audience feel it is very real and also very moved.

examples.chinese: 我伯伯說，讀書與做人同樣重要，也是一輩子的事。與人溝通時，最重要的是讓對方清楚了解你想表達的意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bóbo shuō, dúshū yǔ zuòrén tóngyàng zhòngyào, yě shì yībèizi de shì. Yǔ rén gōutōng shí, zuì zhòngyào de shì ràng duìfāng qīngchǔ liǎojiě nǐ xiǎng biǎodá de yìsi.
examples.english: My uncle says that studying and being a good person are equally important, and are lifelong matters. When communicating with others, the most important thing is to let the other person clearly understand what you want to express.

examples.chinese: 許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
examples.pinyin: Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn. Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.
examples.english: Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient. There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese: 我等一下要開會，不方便接電話，有事就用手機傳訊息給我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děng yīxià yào kāihuì, bù fāngbiàn jiē diànhuà, yǒu shì jiù yòng shǒujī chuán xùnxí gěi wǒ.
examples.english: I have a meeting in a little while, so it's not convenient to answer the phone; if there's anything, just send me a message on my cell phone.

examples.chinese: 林阿姨來我家推銷保險，我不好意思當面拒絕她，只好假裝有急事要出門。
examples.pinyin: Lín āyí lái wǒ jiā tuīxiāo bǎoxiǎn, wǒ bù hǎoyìsi dāngmiàn jùjué tā, zhǐhǎo jiǎzhuāng yǒu jíshì yào chūmén.
examples.english: Auntie Lin came to my house to sell insurance; I was too embarrassed to refuse her in person, so I had no choice but to pretend I had an urgent matter and had to go out.

examples.chinese: 媽媽生病時，小華給家人做飯、照顧弟弟妹妹，真是個懂事的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Māma shēngbìng shí, Xiǎohuá gěi jiārén zuòfàn, zhàogù dìdì mèimei, zhēn shì ge dǒngshì de háizi.
examples.english: When Mom was sick, Xiaohua cooked for the family and took care of his younger brother and sister; he is truly a sensible child.

examples.chinese: 雖然藍先生是大學的校長，可是他很謙虛，經常向同事請教管理學校的方法。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán Lán xiānsheng shì dàxué de xiàozhǎng, kěshì tā hěn qiānxū, jīngcháng xiàng tóngshì qǐngjiào guǎnlǐ xuéxiào de fāngfǎ.
examples.english: Although Mr. Lan is a university president, he is very modest and often asks colleagues for advice on methods for managing the school.

examples.chinese: 史小姐做事很細心，這張表我檢查過好幾次，還是被她發現了幾個錯字。
