examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě zuòshì hěn xìxīn, zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ jiǎnchá guo hǎojǐ cì, háishi bèi tā fāxiàn le jǐ ge cuòzì.
examples.english: Ms. Shi is very careful in her work; I checked this form several times, but she still found a few typos.

examples.chinese: 顏小姐的職場表現很優秀，除了外文能力好，做事也很細心。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiǎojiě de zhíchǎng biǎoxiàn hěn yōuxiù, chúle wàiwén nénglì hǎo, zuòshì yě hěn xìxīn.
examples.english: Ms. Yan's performance in the workplace is outstanding; besides having good foreign language skills, she is also very careful in her work.

examples.chinese: 你聽了尤老闆勇敢克服困難、堅持到底的真實故事，有什麼感想？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng le Yóu lǎobǎn yǒnggǎn kèfú kùnnan, jiānchí dàodǐ de zhēnshí gùshi, yǒu shénme gǎnxiǎng?
examples.english: After hearing Boss You's true story of bravely overcoming difficulties and persevering to the end, what are your thoughts?

examples.chinese: 我妹妹很會做家事，她總是把房間整理得很整齊，連窗戶也擦得很乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei hěn huì zuò jiāshì, tā zǒngshì bǎ fángjiān zhěnglǐ de hěn zhěngqí, lián chuānghu yě cā de hěn gānjìng.
examples.english: My younger sister is very good at doing housework; she always tidies up the room very neatly, and even wipes the windows very clean.

examples.chinese: 杜先生是三家網路商店的主管，他希望將來能當大企業的老闆，擁有自己的事業。
examples.pinyin: Dù xiānsheng shì sān jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn de zhǔguǎn, tā xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng dà qǐyè de lǎobǎn, yǒngyǒu zìjǐ de shìyè.
examples.english: Mr. Du is the manager of three online stores; he hopes that in the future he can become the boss of a big enterprise and have his own career.

examples.chinese: A:聽說小金離婚了，你知道是怎麼回事嗎？ B:唉，這件事說起來都要怪小金，誰教他愛上了別的女生呢！
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Jīn líhūn le, nǐ zhīdào shì zěnme huí shì ma? B: Āi, zhè jiàn shì shuō qǐlái dōu yào guài Xiǎo Jīn, shéi jiào tā ài shàng le bié de nǚshēng ne!
examples.english: A: I heard Xiao Jin got divorced. Do you know what happened? B: Sigh, as a matter of fact, it's all Xiao Jin's fault—who told him to fall in love with another girl!

examples.chinese: 鄰居有急事得出門處理，請我暫時幫他照顧孩子。
examples.pinyin: Línjū yǒu jíshì děi chūmén chǔlǐ, qǐng wǒ zànshí bāng tā zhàogù háizi.
examples.english: My neighbor had an urgent matter to go out and handle, so she asked me to temporarily help take care of her child.

examples.chinese: 如果同事之間不願意溝通，這個會議怎麼開下去呢？
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ tóngshì zhījiān bú yuànyì gōutōng, zhège huìyì zěnme kāi xiàqù ne?
examples.english: If colleagues are unwilling to communicate with each other, how can this meeting continue?

examples.chinese: 這部愛情電影是根據真實故事拍出來的，看過的人都很有感覺。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù àiqíng diànyǐng shì gēnjù zhēnshí gùshì pāi chūlái de, kànguò de rén dōu hěn yǒu gǎnjué.
examples.english: This romance movie was made according to a true story; everyone who has seen it feels deeply moved.

examples.chinese: 小偷：我又沒偷東西，為什麼抓我？ 警察：你先別動，只要看了商店攝影機錄下來的內容，就知道事實了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎotōu: Wǒ yòu méi tōu dōngxi, wèishénme zhuā wǒ? Jǐngchá: Nǐ xiān bié dòng, zhǐyào kàn le shāngdiàn shèyǐngjī lù xiàlái de nèiróng, jiù zhīdào shìshí le.
examples.english: Thief: I didn't steal anything, why are you arresting me? Police: Don't move first; as long as you look at what the store's camera recorded, you'll know the fact.

examples.chinese: 有人以為身體沒什麼毛病就代表很健康，這樣的想法事實上不完全正確。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén yǐwéi shēntǐ méi shénme máobìng jiù dàibiǎo hěn jiànkāng, zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ shìshíshàng bù wánquán zhèngquè.
examples.english: Some people think that if the body has no problems, it means being very healthy; in fact, this idea is not entirely correct.

examples.chinese: 只有圖畫，沒有文字的故事書 ，能夠留給兒童想像及思考的空間。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu túhuà, méiyǒu wénzì de gùshìshū, nénggòu liú gěi értóng xiǎngxiàng jí sīkǎo de kōngjiān.
examples.english: Storybooks with only pictures and no text can leave children room for imagination and thinking.

examples.chinese: 爸爸常教導我做人要謙虛，太驕傲的話，不僅讓人討厭，做事也可能不順利。
examples.pinyin: Bàba cháng jiàodǎo wǒ zuòrén yào qiānxū, tài jiāo'ào de huà, bùjǐn ràng rén tǎoyàn, zuòshì yě kěnéng bù shùnlì.
examples.english: Dad often teaches me to be modest. If you are too arrogant, not only will people dislike you, but things may not go smoothly either.

examples.chinese: 古小姐做事的態度很積極，為了完成任務，總是很早就做好計畫，而且立刻實行。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ xiǎojiě zuòshì de tàidù hěn jījí, wèile wánchéng rènwù, zǒngshì hěn zǎo jiù zuò hǎo jìhuà, érqiě lìkè shíxíng.
examples.english: Miss Gu has a very proactive attitude toward work. In order to complete tasks, she always makes plans early and immediately carries them out.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 這本小說介紹了許多中國的古人古事，內容既豐富又有趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō jièshào le xǔduō Zhōngguó de gǔrén gǔshì, nèiróng jì fēngfù yòu yǒuqù.
examples.english: This novel introduces many stories of ancient Chinese people and events; its content is both rich and interesting.

examples.chinese: 隔壁家的小子相當懂事，附近的鄰居們都很喜歡他。
examples.pinyin: Gébì jiā de xiǎozi xiāngdāng dǒngshì, fùjìn de línjūmen dōu hěn xǐhuān tā.
examples.english: The young fellow next door is quite sensible; the neighbors nearby all like him very much.

examples.chinese: 自己開店做老闆，事事都得自己來，其實不太容易。
examples.pinyin: Zìjǐ kāidiàn zuò lǎobǎn, shìshì dōu děi zìjǐ lái, qíshí bù tài róngyì.
examples.english: Opening your own shop and being the boss means you have to do everything yourself; actually, it's not that easy.

examples.chinese: 我有很急的事找張先生，請他到辦公室後回電，謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu hěn jí de shì zhǎo Zhāng xiānsheng, qǐng tā dào bàngōngshì hòu huídiàn, xièxie.
examples.english: I have something very urgent to discuss with Mr. Zhang; please have him call back after he arrives at the office. Thank you.

examples.chinese: 一個人做錯事多半是自己造成的，不能一做錯就怪別人。
examples.pinyin: Yī ge rén zuòcuò shì duōbàn shì zìjǐ zàochéng de, bùnéng yī zuòcuò jiù guài biérén.
examples.english: When a person does something wrong, it is mostly caused by themselves; you can't just blame others as soon as you make a mistake.

examples.chinese: 叔叔時常跟我聊他到世界各地旅行的故事，真是有意思。
examples.pinyin: Shūshu shícháng gēn wǒ liáo tā dào shìjiè gèdì lǚxíng de gùshì, zhēn shì yǒu yìsi.
examples.english: My uncle often chats with me about his stories of traveling around the world; it's really interesting.

examples.chinese: 我已經退休了，不過還時常跟幾位要好的同事通信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng tuìxiū le, bùguò hái shícháng gēn jǐ wèi yàohǎo de tóngshì tōngxìn.
examples.english: I have already retired, but I still often correspond with a few close colleagues.

examples.chinese: 小王做事非常粗心，因此公司一直不敢把重要的業務交給他。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng zuòshì fēicháng cūxīn, yīncǐ gōngsī yīzhí bù gǎn bǎ zhòngyào de yèwù jiāo gěi tā.
examples.english: Xiao Wang is very careless in doing things, so the company has never dared to hand important business over to him.

examples.chinese: 他有一點兒膽小，又容易緊張，我看這件事你先別告訴他。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu yìdiǎnr dǎnxiǎo, yòu róngyì jǐnzhāng, wǒ kàn zhè jiàn shì nǐ xiān bié gàosu tā.
examples.english: He is a bit timid and also easily gets nervous; I think you'd better not tell him about this matter yet.

examples.chinese: 有人說，想了解一個人的真心，就得看他做的事、他說的話。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, xiǎng liǎojiě yí ge rén de zhēnxīn, jiù děi kàn tā zuò de shì, tā shuō de huà.
examples.english: Some people say that if you want to understand a person's sincerity, you have to look at what they do and what they say.

examples.chinese: 答應別人的事就要做到，這才是有信用的人。
examples.pinyin: Dāying biérén de shì jiù yào zuòdào, zhè cái shì yǒu xìnyòng de rén.
examples.english: When you agree to do something for someone, you must do it—only then are you a person with credit.

examples.chinese: 我要去郵局辦事，有什麼事要我順便替你辦的嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù yóujú bànshì, yǒu shénme shì yào wǒ shùnbiàn tì nǐ bàn de ma?
examples.english: I'm going to the post office to handle some affairs; is there anything you want me to handle for you while I'm at it?

examples.chinese: 銀行裡有很多種表格，看你辦什麼事，就用什麼表格。
examples.pinyin: Yínháng lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhǒng biǎogé, kàn nǐ bàn shénme shì, jiù yòng shénme biǎogé.
examples.english: There are many kinds of forms in the bank; depending on what you're doing, you use the corresponding form.

examples.chinese: 他做事很慢，時常要人催他。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì hěn màn, shícháng yào rén cuī tā.
examples.english: He does things very slowly; he often needs people to press him.

examples.chinese: 不管做任何事都應先了解情況，省得白花精神。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn zuò rènhé shì dōu yīng xiān liǎojiě qíngkuàng, shěngde bái huā jīngshén.
examples.english: No matter what you do, you should first understand the situation, so as to avoid wasting energy in vain.

examples.chinese: 小張的個性比較懶，很少主動幫同事的忙。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng de gèxìng bǐjiào lǎn, hěn shǎo zhǔdòng bāng tóngshì de máng.
examples.english: Little Zhang's personality is rather lazy; he rarely takes the initiative to help his colleagues.

examples.chinese: 這件事他就可以幫你了，你還用得著去別的地方請人嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì tā jiù kěyǐ bāng nǐ le, nǐ hái yòngdezháo qù bié de dìfāng qǐng rén ma?
examples.english: He can help you with this matter, so do you still need to go ask someone else elsewhere?

examples.chinese: 他個性獨立，加上做事總是很細心，因此老闆很欣賞他。
examples.pinyin: Tā gèxìng dúlì, jiāshàng zuòshì zǒngshì hěn xìxīn, yīncǐ lǎobǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: He has an independent personality; on top of that, he is always very careful in doing things, so the boss appreciates him very much.

examples.chinese: 跟朋友飲酒是一件開心的事，不過飲酒過度卻可能傷害身體。
examples.pinyin: Gēn péngyǒu yǐn jiǔ shì yí jiàn kāixīn de shì, búguò yǐn jiǔ guòdù què kěnéng shānghài shēntǐ.
examples.english: Drinking alcohol with friends is a happy thing, but excessive drinking may harm your health.

examples.chinese: 太太：要是你閒著沒事，就幫我泡一壺熱茶吧。先生：我哪裡閒？我馬上要開雲端會議了，可是忙得很呢！
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Yàoshi nǐ xián zhe méishì, jiù bāng wǒ pào yī hú rè chá ba. Xiānsheng: Wǒ nǎlǐ xián? Wǒ mǎshàng yào kāi yúnduān huìyì le, kěshì máng de hěn ne!
examples.english: Wife: If you're idle with nothing to do, then help me brew a pot of hot tea. Husband: How am I idle? I'm about to start a cloud meeting; I'm really busy!

examples.chinese: 同事搬新家，我們送他一組茶具，恭喜他吧。
examples.pinyin: Tóngshì bān xīn jiā, wǒmen sòng tā yī zǔ chájù, gōngxǐ tā ba.
examples.english: A colleague is moving to a new home; let's give him a tea set to congratulate him.

examples.chinese: 公司的午餐時間很短，因此同事們總是吃得很趕。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de wǔcān shíjiān hěn duǎn, yīncǐ tóngshìmen zǒngshì chī de hěn gǎn.
examples.english: The company's lunch break is very short, so colleagues always eat in a hurry.

examples.chinese: 到別人家做客時不能太隨便，以免發生不愉快的事。
examples.pinyin: Dào biérén jiā zuòkè shí bù néng tài suíbiàn, yǐmiǎn fāshēng bù yúkuài de shì.
examples.english: When you are a guest at someone else’s home, you must not be too casual, so as to avoid unpleasant things happening.

examples.chinese: 完全按照別人的話來工作，是很省事沒錯，卻失去了讓自己進步的機會。
examples.pinyin: Wánquán ànzhào biérén de huà lái gōngzuò, shì hěn shěngshì méicuò, què shīqù le ràng zìjǐ jìnbù de jīhuì.
examples.english: Working completely according to others' words is indeed very trouble-saving, but it loses the opportunity to let yourself improve.

examples.chinese: 做任何事以前要先想清楚，這麼做會有什麼後果。
examples.pinyin: Zuò rènhé shì yǐqián yào xiān xiǎng qīngchu, zhème zuò huì yǒu shénme hòuguǒ.
examples.english: Before doing anything, you must first think clearly what consequences doing so will have.

examples.chinese: 再過幾天就要過年了，在此願大家新年平安，事事如意。
examples.pinyin: Zài guò jǐ tiān jiù yào guònián le, zài cǐ yuàn dàjiā xīnnián píng'ān, shìshì rúyì.
examples.english: In a few days it will be Chinese New Year; here I wish everyone a peaceful new year and that everything goes as you wish.

examples.chinese: 停電(power failure)的時候有支手電筒，做起事來比較方便。
examples.pinyin: Tíngdiàn de shíhòu yǒu zhī shǒudiàntǒng, zuò qǐ shì lái bǐjiào fāngbiàn.
examples.english: When there is a power failure, having a flashlight makes doing things more convenient.

examples.chinese: 那件事我已經跟你重複說過好多次了，你怎麼還問我？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn shì wǒ yǐjīng gēn nǐ chóngfù shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme hái wèn wǒ?
examples.english: I have already said that matter to you repeatedly many times; how come you are still asking me?

examples.chinese: 人的一生就如一場電影，故事中的每個人都是主角。
examples.pinyin: Rén de yīshēng jiù rú yī chǎng diànyǐng, gùshì zhōng de měi gè rén dōu shì zhǔjiǎo.
examples.english: A person's life is like a movie; everyone in the story is the main character.

examples.chinese: 今天兩小時的會議，因為要討論的事增加而延長了三十分。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān liǎng xiǎoshí de huìyì, yīnwèi yào tǎolùn de shì zēngjiā ér yáncháng le sānshí fēn.
examples.english: Today's two-hour meeting was extended by thirty minutes because the matters to discuss increased.

examples.chinese: 有好的投資機會就該好好掌握，不要等到事後才開始後悔。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu hǎo de tóuzī jīhuì jiù gāi hǎohǎo zhǎngwò, bùyào děngdào shìhòu cái kāishǐ hòuhuǐ.
examples.english: When there is a good investment opportunity, you should grasp it well; don't wait until afterwards to start regretting.

examples.chinese: 對自己的事業很熱情的人，就不怕挑戰任何困難。
examples.pinyin: Duì zìjǐ de shìyè hěn rèqíng de rén, jiù bù pà tiǎozhàn rènhé kùnnán.
examples.english: People who are very passionate about their careers are not afraid to challenge any difficulties.

examples.chinese: 如果從事某項工作能令你忘掉時間，或許就可當作一生的事業。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ cóngshì mǒu xiàng gōngzuò néng lìng nǐ wàngdiào shíjiān, huòxǔ jiù kě dàngzuò yīshēng de shìyè.
examples.english: If being engaged in a certain job can make you forget time, perhaps it can be treated as a lifelong career.

examples.chinese: 一個政府如果事事控制人民，沒有給人民自由，就不是個理想的政府。
examples.pinyin: Yī gè zhèngfǔ rúguǒ shìshì kòngzhì rénmín, méiyǒu gěi rénmín zìyóu, jiù bù shì gè lǐxiǎng de zhèngfǔ.
examples.english: If a government controls the people in everything and does not give the people freedom, it is not an ideal government.

examples.chinese: 春天是花開的季節，在愛情故事中，往往也是適合戀愛的季節。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān shì huā kāi de jìjié, zài àiqíng gùshì zhōng, wǎngwǎng yě shì shìhé liàn'ài de jìjié.
examples.english: Spring is the season when flowers blossom; in love stories, it is often also the season suitable for falling in love.

examples.chinese: 登山的時候得注意安全，事前多準備，才能享受登山的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Dēngshān de shíhou děi zhùyì ānquán, shìqián duō zhǔnbèi, cái néng xiǎngshòu dēngshān de lèqù.
examples.english: When climbing a mountain, you must pay attention to safety; prepare more beforehand so you can enjoy the fun of mountain climbing.

examples.chinese: 上次你跟我提的事，我一點兒印象都沒有，真是不好意思。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì nǐ gēn wǒ tí de shì, wǒ yìdiǎnr yìnxiàng dōu méiyǒu, zhēn shì bù hǎoyìsi.
examples.english: The matter you mentioned to me last time—I don't have the slightest impression of it; I'm really sorry.

examples.chinese: 你的商品計畫，我可以幫你一起做，反正我晚上沒事。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de shāngpǐn jìhuà, wǒ kěyǐ bāng nǐ yìqǐ zuò, fǎnzhèng wǒ wǎnshang méi shì.
examples.english: I can help you work on your product plan together; anyway, I have nothing to do tonight.

examples.chinese: 那項新產品的設計圖你一個人負責太辛苦了，倒不如找同事一起來做。
examples.pinyin: Nà xiàng xīn chǎnpǐn de shèjìtú nǐ yī gè rén fùzé tài xīnkǔ le, dào bùrú zhǎo tóngshì yīqǐ lái zuò.
examples.english: It's too hard for you to be responsible for that new product's design drawings all by yourself; it would be better to find colleagues to do it together.

examples.chinese: 我的同事遲到的次數太多了，這個月被扣了半個月的薪水。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de tóngshì chídào de cìshù tài duō le, zhè ge yuè bèi kòu le bàn ge yuè de xīnshuǐ.
examples.english: My colleague has been late too many times; this month half a month's salary was deducted.

examples.chinese: 時間有時能消除煩惱，不能解決的事就暫時放在一邊吧。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān yǒu shí néng xiāochú fánnǎo, bù néng jiějué de shì jiù zànshí fàng zài yìbiān ba.
examples.english: Time can sometimes eliminate worries; for things that can't be solved, just put them aside for the time being.

examples.chinese: A:你說自己沒有想做的事，難道你沒有夢想嗎？ B:我只想簡單過生活，再說，沒有夢想難道不行嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shuō zìjǐ méiyǒu xiǎng zuò de shì, nándào nǐ méiyǒu mèngxiǎng ma? B: Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng jiǎndān guò shēnghuó, zàishuō, méiyǒu mèngxiǎng nándào bùxíng ma?
examples.english: A: You say you have nothing you want to do—don't you have dreams? B: I just want to live a simple life; besides, is it not okay to have no dreams?

examples.chinese: 公司上頭要求小張一個人完成任務，同事們都認為有點兒勉強。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī shàngtóu yāoqiú Xiǎo Zhāng yī gè rén wánchéng rènwu, tóngshìmen dōu rènwéi yǒudiǎnr miǎnqiǎng.
examples.english: The company higher-ups asked Xiao Zhang to complete the task alone; his colleagues all thought it was a bit of a stretch.

examples.chinese: 你不需要事事都跟別人做比較，自己過得輕鬆愉快就好。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù xūyào shìshì dōu gēn biérén zuò bǐjiào, zìjǐ guò de qīngsōng yúkuài jiù hǎo.
examples.english: You don't need to compare yourself with others in everything; it's fine as long as you live relaxed and happy.

examples.chinese: 有些事明明不對，卻因沒人敢說，久了以後就被社會接受了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì míngmíng bù duì, què yīn méi rén gǎn shuō, jiǔ le yǐhòu jiù bèi shèhuì jiēshòu le.
examples.english: Some things are obviously wrong, yet because no one dares to speak up, after a long time they are accepted by society.

examples.chinese: 夏天在海灘上踏著浪散步，是一件非常享受的事。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān zài hǎitān shàng tà zhe làng sànbù, shì yí jiàn fēicháng xiǎngshòu de shì.
examples.english: In summer, strolling on the beach while stepping on the waves is a very enjoyable thing.

examples.chinese: 他一有不順心的事，就會嘮叨個沒完，有時真讓人受不了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì yǒu bú shùnxīn de shì, jiù huì láodao ge méiwán, yǒushí zhēn ràng rén shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: Whenever he has something unpleasant, he will nag endlessly; sometimes it really is unbearable.

examples.chinese: 到外面做了丟人的事，自己和家人也會覺得丟臉。
examples.pinyin: Dào wàimiàn zuò le diūrén de shì, zìjǐ hé jiārén yě huì juéde diūliǎn.
examples.english: If you go out and do something shameful, you and your family will also feel disgraced.

examples.chinese: 為了發展個人事業而放下學業，多數人是很難做到的。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fāzhǎn gèrén shìyè ér fàngxià xuéyè, duōshù rén shì hěn nán zuòdào de.
examples.english: To give up one's studies in order to develop a personal career is something most people find very hard to do.

examples.chinese: 除非別人願意，否則你不該強迫其他人全按你的意見做事。
examples.pinyin: Chúfēi biérén yuànyì, fǒuzé nǐ bù gāi qiángpò qítā rén quán àn nǐ de yìjiàn zuòshì.
examples.english: Unless others are willing, otherwise you should not force other people to do everything according to your opinion.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸認為我們這一代做事不夠積極，缺少耐心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba rènwéi wǒmen zhè yī dài zuòshì bù gòu jījí, quēshǎo nàixīn.
examples.english: My dad thinks our generation is not proactive enough in doing things and lacks patience.

examples.chinese: 經過那次任務教訓後，小周做事就變得更加小心了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò nà cì rènwu jiàoxùn hòu, Xiǎo Zhōu zuòshì jiù biàn de gèngjiā xiǎoxīn le.
examples.english: After the lesson from that mission, Xiao Zhou became even more careful in doing things.

examples.chinese: 不要僅根據表面來判斷一個人或一件事，得花時間深入瞭解。
examples.pinyin: Bùyào jǐn gēnjù biǎomiàn lái pànduàn yī gè rén huò yī jiàn shì, děi huā shíjiān shēnrù liǎojiě.
examples.english: Don't judge a person or a matter based only on the surface; you must spend time to understand deeply.

examples.chinese: 做事不順利時別只想著逃避，得好好面對才行。
examples.pinyin: Zuòshì bù shùnlì shí bié zhǐ xiǎngzhe táobì, děi hǎohǎo miànduì cái xíng.
examples.english: When things don't go smoothly, don't just think about escaping; you must face them properly.

examples.chinese: 有些事忍耐一下就過去了，什麼都想以吵架的方式解決，遲早會出事的。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì rěnnài yīxià jiù guòqù le, shénme dōu xiǎng yǐ chǎojià de fāngshì jiějué, chízǎo huì chūshì de.
examples.english: Some things pass after enduring them for a bit; if you want to solve everything by arguing, sooner or later there will be an accident.

examples.chinese: 對夏天一活動汗就流個不停的女性來說，化妝實在是件麻煩事。
examples.pinyin: Duì xiàtiān yī huódòng hàn jiù liú ge bùtíng de nǚxìng lái shuō, huàzhuāng shízài shì jiàn máfan shì.
examples.english: For women who sweat nonstop as soon as they move in summer, putting on makeup is really a troublesome thing.

examples.chinese: 當別人遇到不愉快的事時，應該避免說些刺激他的話。
examples.pinyin: Dāng biérén yùdào bù yúkuài de shì shí, yīnggāi bìmiǎn shuō xiē cìjī tā de huà.
examples.english: When others encounter unpleasant things, one should avoid saying things that irritate them.

examples.chinese: 黃媽媽感冒那幾天，她女兒每天煮粥給她吃，真是懂事。
examples.pinyin: Huáng māma gǎnmào nà jǐ tiān, tā nǚ'ér měitiān zhǔ zhōu gěi tā chī, zhēn shì dǒngshì.
examples.english: During the days when Mrs. Huang had a cold, her daughter cooked porridge for her every day; she is really sensible.

examples.chinese: 我好友都已結婚了，什麼時候才換我辦喜事，請大家喝喜酒？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎoyǒu dōu yǐjīng jiéhūn le, shénme shíhòu cái huàn wǒ bàn xǐshì, qǐng dàjiā hē xǐjiǔ?
examples.english: All my good friends are already married; when will it be my turn to hold a wedding and invite everyone to drink at the wedding banquet?

examples.chinese: 聽說那位新郎在事業上很有成就，況且優點也不少，跟他結婚的女人應該很幸福。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà wèi xīnláng zài shìyè shàng hěn yǒu chéngjiù, kuàngqiě yōudiǎn yě bù shǎo, gēn tā jiéhūn de nǚrén yīnggāi hěn xìngfú.
examples.english: I heard that bridegroom has great achievements in his career, and moreover has many good qualities; the woman who marries him should be very happy.

examples.chinese: 我同事下個月總算要和交往十年的女朋友結婚了，真是不容易啊！。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì xià ge yuè zǒngsuàn yào hé jiāowǎng shí nián de nǚpéngyǒu jiéhūn le, zhēn shì bù róngyì a!
examples.english: My colleague is finally going to marry his girlfriend of ten years next month—it really wasn't easy!

examples.chinese: 王伯伯為兒子辦喜事，擺了五十桌喜酒，熱鬧極了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng bóbo wèi érzi bàn xǐshì, bǎi le wǔshí zhuō xǐjiǔ, rènào jí le.
examples.english: Uncle Wang held a wedding for his son and set up fifty tables of wedding wine—it was extremely lively.

examples.chinese: 她想嫁給有錢人家(rénjiā)是她自己的事，你幹嘛管人家(rénjia)的事？
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng jià gěi yǒuqián rénjiā shì tā zìjǐ de shì, nǐ gànmá guǎn rénjia de shì?
examples.english: That she wants to marry into a wealthy family is her own business; why do you meddle in other people's business?

examples.chinese: 看見別人事業很成功，除了羨慕以外，更要學習他的優點。
examples.pinyin: Kànjiàn biérén shìyè hěn chénggōng, chúle xiànmù yǐwài, gèng yào xuéxí tā de yōudiǎn.
examples.english: When you see others being very successful in their careers, besides envying them, you should also learn from their strengths.

examples.chinese: 故事中的女主角吻了白馬一下，白馬就變成了英俊的國王。
examples.pinyin: Gùshì zhōng de nǚzhǔjiǎo wěn le báimǎ yīxià, báimǎ jiù biànchéng le yīngjùn de guówáng.
examples.english: The female protagonist in the story kissed the white horse once, and the white horse turned into a handsome king.

examples.chinese: 這對夫婦打扮得相當講究，讓我對他們從事的行業很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duì fūfù dǎbàn de xiāngdāng jiǎngjiū, ràng wǒ duì tāmen cóngshì de hángyè hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: This couple dresses quite elegantly, which makes me very interested in the profession they are engaged in.

examples.chinese: 個性親切、大方，通常是從事服務業的最佳人才。
examples.pinyin: Gèxìng qīnqiè, dàfāng, tōngcháng shì cóngshì fúwùyè de zuìjiā réncái.
examples.english: People with a friendly and generous personality are usually the best talent for working in the service industry.

examples.chinese: 紀念郵票一般都是以歷史上的大事或重要人物當作主題。
examples.pinyin: Jìniàn yóupiào yībān dōu shì yǐ lìshǐ shàng de dàshì huò zhòngyào rénwù dàngzuò zhǔtí.
examples.english: Commemorative stamps generally use major historical events or important figures as their themes.

examples.chinese: 遇人少比較，遇事放得下，日子就能過得更輕鬆自在。
examples.pinyin: Yù rén shǎo bǐjiào, yù shì fàng de xià, rìzi jiù néng guò de gèng qīngsōng zìzài.
examples.english: Meet people with fewer comparisons, and let go of things when you encounter them; then life can be lived more easily and comfortably.

examples.chinese: 想導演一部以蟲子當作主角的電影，真不是件容易的事。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng dǎoyǎn yī bù yǐ chóngzi dàngzuò zhǔjiǎo de diànyǐng, zhēn bù shì jiàn róngyì de shì.
examples.english: Wanting to direct a movie with insects as the main characters is really not an easy thing.

examples.chinese: 從事電視新聞工作的人有義務傳播正確的消息。
examples.pinyin: Cóngshì diànshì xīnwén gōngzuò de rén yǒu yìwù chuánbō zhèngquè de xiāoxi.
examples.english: People working in television news have an obligation to disseminate correct information.

examples.chinese: 小張出車禍雖然賠了很多錢，不過好在人沒事。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng chū chēhuò suīrán péi le hěn duō qián, bùguò hǎozài rén méi shì.
examples.english: Although Xiao Zhang had a car accident and paid a lot of money, fortunately no one was hurt.

examples.chinese: 李伯伯對做家事有很多妙主意，因此附近的鄰居常向他請教。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ bóbo duì zuò jiāshì yǒu hěn duō miào zhǔyi, yīncǐ fùjìn de línjū cháng xiàng tā qǐngjiào.
examples.english: Uncle Li has many clever ideas for doing housework, so neighbors nearby often ask him for advice.

examples.chinese: 今天王醫師門診，沒有護理師協助，什麼事都得自己動手。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān Wáng yīshī ménzhěn, méiyǒu hùlǐshī xiézhù, shénme shì dōu děi zìjǐ dòngshǒu.
examples.english: Dr. Wang is seeing patients today, and without a nurse assisting, he has to set about everything himself.

examples.chinese: 祕書趁老闆不在把商品計畫偷走，這事已經交給法院處理了。
examples.pinyin: Mìshū chèn lǎobǎn bú zài bǎ shāngpǐn jìhuà tōu zǒu, zhè shì yǐjīng jiāo gěi fǎyuàn chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: The secretary took advantage of the boss's absence to steal the product plan; this matter has already been handed over to the court.

examples.chinese: 她沒有針對此事發表看法，所以不知道她贊不贊成。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu zhēnduì cǐ shì fābiǎo kànfǎ, suǒyǐ bù zhīdào tā zàn bù zànchéng.
examples.english: She didn't express her views on this matter, so we don't know whether she approves or not.

examples.chinese: 無論發生什麼事，她都會跟父母商量，並參考他們的意見。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn fāshēng shénme shì, tā dōu huì gēn fùmǔ shāngliang, bìng cānkǎo tāmen de yìjiàn.
examples.english: No matter what happens, she will discuss it with her parents and refer to their opinions.

examples.chinese: 從事新工作時往往經驗不足，因此向別人請教是必需的。
examples.pinyin: Cóngshì xīn gōngzuò shí wǎngwǎng jīngyàn bùzú, yīncǐ xiàng biérén qǐngjiào shì bìxū de.
examples.english: When starting a new job, one often lacks experience, so asking others for advice is necessary.

examples.chinese: 父母反對她從事電影行業，哪怕收入很高，還是不贊成。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ fǎnduì tā cóngshì diànyǐng hángyè, nǎpà shōurù hěn gāo, háishì bù zànchéng.
examples.english: Her parents oppose her working in the film industry; even if the income is high, they still do not approve.

examples.chinese: 這件事我根本不了解，所以沒辦法給你適當的建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ gēnběn bù liǎojiě, suǒyǐ méi bànfǎ gěi nǐ shìdàng de jiànyì.
examples.english: I simply don't understand this matter at all, so I have no way to give you appropriate advice.

examples.chinese: 無論做錯事或出差錯，任何人都應主動負起責任。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn zuòcuò shì huò chū chācuò, rènhé rén dōu yīng zhǔdòng fùqǐ zérèn.
examples.english: Whether you do something wrong or a mistake occurs, anyone should take responsibility proactively.

examples.chinese: 老方住院開刀時，同事們都輪流到醫院慰問並照顧他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Fāng zhùyuàn kāidāo shí, tóngshìmen dōu lúnliú dào yīyuàn wèiwèn bìng zhàogù tā.
examples.english: When Old Fang was hospitalized for surgery, his colleagues all took turns going to the hospital to comfort and take care of him.

examples.chinese: 他勸我別太在意別人的眼光，把自己負責的事完成就好。
examples.pinyin: Tā quàn wǒ bié tài zàiyì biérén de yǎnguāng, bǎ zìjǐ fùzé de shì wánchéng jiù hǎo.
examples.english: He advised me not to care too much about others' opinions, and to just complete the things I am responsible for.

examples.chinese: 這次的說話比賽要求參加的學生說一個神奇的外國故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuōhuà bǐsài yāoqiú cānjiā de xuéshēng shuō yī gè shénqí de wàiguó gùshì.
examples.english: This speech contest requires participating students to tell a magical foreign story.

examples.chinese: 公司來了位新同事，老闆要我向他一一介紹公司的規定。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī lái le wèi xīn tóngshì, lǎobǎn yào wǒ xiàng tā yīyī jièshào gōngsī de guīdìng.
examples.english: A new colleague came to the company, and the boss asked me to introduce the company's rules to him one by one.

examples.chinese: 這件事大家都堅持自己的觀點，討論不出結果，還是找個說話有分量的人來決定吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì dàjiā dōu jiānchí zìjǐ de guāndiǎn, tǎolùn bù chū jiéguǒ, háishì zhǎo gè shuōhuà yǒu fènliàng de rén lái juédìng ba.
examples.english: In this matter, everyone insists on their own viewpoint, and no result can be reached through discussion; it would be better to find someone whose words carry weight to decide.

examples.chinese: 我們打算用擲銅錢的方式，來決定讓誰處理這件事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn yòng zhì tóngqián de fāngshì, lái juédìng ràng shéi chǔlǐ zhè jiàn shì.
examples.english: We plan to use the method of tossing a copper coin to decide who will handle this matter.

examples.chinese: 他告訴孩子不需要事事追求第一，但做任何事都必須盡力。
examples.pinyin: Tā gàosù háizi bù xūyào shìshì zhuīqiú dì yī, dàn zuò rènhé shì dōu bìxū jìnlì.
examples.english: He told his children that they don't need to pursue first place in everything, but they must strive their hardest in whatever they do.

examples.chinese: 這次活動是公司主辦的，目的是為了增加同事之間的感情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng shì gōngsī zhǔbàn de, mùdì shì wèile zēngjiā tóngshì zhījiān de gǎnqíng.
examples.english: This event is organized by the company, and the purpose is to increase the bonds among colleagues.

items.wordHook: 事(affair) + 情(circumstances) → 事情 is a matter.

examples.chinese: 我在客廳等了他一晚，真累！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài kètīng děng le tā yī wǎn, zhēn lèi!
examples.english: I waited for him in the living room all evening, really tired!

examples.chinese: 明天晚上學校有一個新年晚會，你會去參加嗎？
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǎnshang xuéxiào yǒu yī gè xīnnián wǎnhuì, nǐ huì qù cānjiā ma?
examples.english: Tomorrow evening the school has a New Year evening event, will you go to participate?

examples.chinese: 現在很晚了，你應該去睡覺了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn wǎn le, nǐ yīnggāi qù shuìjiào le.
examples.english: It's very late now; you should go to sleep.

examples.chinese: B:好，沒問題？ A:我們明天晚上八點見。
examples.pinyin: B: Hǎo, méi wèntí? A: Wǒmen míngtiān wǎnshang bā diǎn jiàn.
examples.english: B: Okay, no problem? A: Let's see each other at eight tomorrow evening.

examples.chinese: 下班以後，我常跟同事一起去吃晚飯。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, wǒ cháng gēn tóngshì yìqǐ qù chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: After getting off work, I often go to eat dinner with colleagues.

examples.chinese: 他每天早上去上班，晚上去上課，真辛苦！
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang qù shàngbān, wǎnshang qù shàngkè, zhēn xīnkǔ!
examples.english: He goes to work every morning and goes to class in the evening; it's really tough!

examples.chinese: 我爸爸是老師，他很喜歡他的工作。他在餐廳工作，每天差不多都晚上十點回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba shì lǎoshī, tā hěn xǐhuān tā de gōngzuò. Tā zài cāntīng gōngzuò, měitiān chàbuduō dōu wǎnshàng shí diǎn huí jiā.
examples.english: My dad is a teacher; he really likes his job. He works at a restaurant, and he almost always gets home around ten at night every day.

examples.chinese: A:你現在有空嗎？ B:我現在要跟太太出去，晚上再給你打電話。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yǒu kòng ma? B: Wǒ xiànzài yào gēn tàitai chūqù, wǎnshàng zài gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.english: A: Are you free now? B: I'm going out with my wife now; I'll call you again in the evening.

examples.chinese: 姐姐每天晚上都讀書，她進步了很多。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, tā jìnbù le hěn duō.
examples.english: My older sister studies every evening; she has improved a lot.

examples.chinese: 學校的圖書館早上八點開，晚上九點關。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de túshūguǎn zǎoshang bā diǎn kāi, wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: The school library opens at 8 a.m. and closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 我今天晚上要去同學家玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān wǎnshang yào qù tóngxué jiā wán.
examples.english: I am going to hang out with my classmate at his/her place tonight.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 聽說這部電影很有趣，我們晚一起去看，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù. Wǒmen wǎnshang yìqǐ qù kàn, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: I heard that this movie is very interesting. How about we go to see it tonight?

examples.chinese: 謝謝！明天晚上六點來我家，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Xièxie! Míngtiān wǎnshang liù diǎn lái wǒ jiā, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: Thanks! How about coming to my place at 6 p.m. tomorrow?

examples.chinese: A:中明，請問學校圖書館幾點關？ B:你不知道啊？圖書館晚上九點關 。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhōngmíng, qǐngwèn xuéxiào túshūguǎn jǐ diǎn guān? B: Nǐ bù zhīdào a? Túshūguǎn wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: A: Zhongming, may I ask what time the school library closes? B: You don't know? The library closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 公園的音樂晚會快要開始了，可不可以請你們幫我排那些椅子？
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán de yīnyuè wǎnhuì kuài yào kāishǐ le, kě bù kěyǐ qǐng nǐmen bāng wǒ pái nàxiē yǐzi?
examples.english: The park's music evening party is about to start; could you please help me line up those chairs?

examples.chinese: 從昨天晚上到現在，已經下了十個小時的雨了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zuótiān wǎnshang dào xiànzài, yǐjīng xià le shí ge xiǎoshí de yǔ le.
examples.english: From last night until now, it has already rained for ten hours.

examples.chinese: 晚上的風很舒服，我們一起出去走走吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnshang de fēng hěn shūfu, wǒmen yìqǐ chūqù zǒuzou ba.
examples.english: The evening wind is very comfortable; let's go out for a walk together.

examples.chinese: 晚安！希望你有個好夢。
examples.pinyin: Wǎn'ān! Xīwàng nǐ yǒu ge hǎo mèng.
examples.english: Good night! I hope you have a good dream.

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？昨天晚上沒睡好嗎？ B:嗯。要不是開夜車趕報告， 現在也不會這麼沒精神。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Zuótiān wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo ma? B: Ńg. Yàobùshì kāi yèchē gǎn bàogào, xiànzài yě bù huì zhème méi jīngshén.
examples.english: A: What's wrong with you? Didn't you sleep well last night? B: Mm. If I hadn't stayed up late driving to finish my report, I wouldn't be so low on energy now.

examples.chinese: 小韓早晚都打工，是因為想多存一些錢，早一點完成出國念書的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán zǎowǎn dōu dǎgōng, shì yīnwèi xiǎng duō cún yìxiē qián, zǎo yìdiǎn wánchéng chūguó niànshū de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Xiao Han works part-time in the morning and evening because he wants to save more money and fulfill his dream of studying abroad earlier.

examples.chinese: 昨天小康碰到一位好久不見的老朋友，他們聊天聊到很晚才回家。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān Xiǎo Kāng pèng dào yí wèi hǎojiǔ bú jiàn de lǎo péngyǒu, tāmen liáotiān liáo dào hěn wǎn cái huí jiā.
examples.english: Yesterday, Xiao Kang bumped into an old friend he hadn't seen for a long time; they chatted until very late before going home.

examples.chinese: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 我昨天晚上做了一個夢，夢到跟我最喜歡的明星一同演戲，開心得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le yī gè mèng, mèng dào gēn wǒ zuì xǐhuan de míngxīng yītóng yǎnxì, kāixīn de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last night I had a dream; I dreamed of acting together with my favorite celebrity, and I was incredibly happy.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上突然發生強烈地震，學校旁的那座橋塌了，還好沒人受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng tūrán fāshēng qiángliè dìzhèn, xuéxiào páng de nà zuò qiáo tā le, hái hǎo méi rén shòushāng.
examples.english: Last night a strong earthquake suddenly occurred; the bridge beside the school collapsed, but fortunately no one was injured.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上的風雨聲好可怕，讓我整個晚上都沒睡好。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng de fēngyǔ shēng hǎo kěpà, ràng wǒ zhěnggè wǎnshàng dōu méi shuì hǎo.
examples.english: Last night the sound of wind and rain was so scary that it kept me from sleeping well the whole night.

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，人們喜歡在屋子外面吹著風、喝著茶，聊聊有趣的事。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, rénmen xǐhuān zài wūzi wàimiàn chuī zhe fēng, hē zhe chá, liáoliao yǒuqù de shì.
examples.english: On summer nights, people like to be outside the house, feeling the breeze, drinking tea, and chatting about interesting things.

examples.chinese: 我家在大馬路旁，從早到晚噪音不斷，嚴重影響了生活品質，所以決定搬家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài dà mǎlù páng, cóng zǎo dào wǎn zàoyīn bùduàn, yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng le shēnghuó pǐnzhí, suǒyǐ juédìng bānjiā.
examples.english: My home is next to a major road, and there is constant noise from morning till night, which has seriously affected our quality of life, so we decided to move.

examples.chinese: 我們樂團今晚的表演很成功，一起放煙火來慶祝吧！
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuètuán jīnwǎn de biǎoyǎn hěn chénggōng, yīqǐ fàng yānhuǒ lái qìngzhù ba!
examples.english: Our band's performance tonight was very successful; let's set off fireworks together to celebrate!

examples.chinese: 秋天的天氣變化很大，早晚都有點涼，出門時最好帶件外套。 這碗魚湯要趁熱喝，涼了就不好喝了。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān de tiānqì biànhuà hěn dà, zǎowǎn dōu yǒudiǎn liáng, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài jiàn wàitào. Zhè wǎn yútāng yào chèn rè hē, liáng le jiù bù hǎohē le.
examples.english: Autumn weather changes a lot; it's a bit chilly morning and evening, so it's best to bring a jacket when going out. This bowl of fish soup should be drunk while hot; once it's cold, it won't taste good.

examples.chinese: 住在學校宿舍有一些限制，比如說晚上十點前必須回到宿舍。
examples.pinyin: Zhù zài xuéxiào sùshè yǒu yīxiē xiànzhì, bǐrú shuō wǎnshang shí diǎn qián bìxū huídào sùshè.
examples.english: Living in the school dormitory has some restrictions, for example, you must return to the dormitory before ten o'clock at night.

examples.chinese: 弟弟做了一個可怕的夢，夜裡三點就醒了。台灣的夏天熱極了，要是房間沒有冷氣，半夜可能會被熱醒，甚至整個晚上睡不著。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi zuò le yí ge kěpà de mèng, yèlǐ sān diǎn jiù xǐng le. Táiwān de xiàtiān rè jí le, yàoshi fángjiān méiyǒu lěngqì, bànyè kěnéng huì bèi rè xǐng, shènzhì zhěnggè wǎnshang shuì bù zháo.
examples.english: My younger brother had a scary dream and woke up at 3 a.m. Summers in Taiwan are extremely hot; if the room has no air conditioning, you might be woken up by the heat in the middle of the night, or even be unable to sleep all night.

examples.chinese: 明天要考五科，每科的測驗題目各有五十題，我想今天晚上得開夜車了。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎo wǔ kē, měi kē de cèyàn tímù gè yǒu wǔshí tí, wǒ xiǎng jīntiān wǎnshang děi kāi yèchē le.
examples.english: Tomorrow I have exams in five subjects; each subject has fifty test questions, so I think tonight I'll have to burn the midnight oil.

examples.chinese: 弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好。為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi yīnwèi míngtiān yào qù dàxué miànshì, jǐnzhāng de zhěnggè wǎnshang dōu shuì bù hǎo. Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì de miànshì, wǒ kàn le hěnduō xiāngguān zīliào, hái búduàn de liànxí miànshì shí gēn zhǔguǎn de duìhuà.
examples.english: Because my younger brother is going to a university interview tomorrow, he was so nervous that he couldn't sleep well the whole night. In order to prepare for this interview, I read a lot of related information and also constantly practiced the conversation with the manager during the interview.

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，在院子裡吹著涼快的風，欣賞天空美麗的星星， 簡直就像在天堂一樣。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, zài yuànzi lǐ chuīzhe liángkuai de fēng, xīnshǎng tiānkōng měilì de xīngxing, jiǎnzhí jiù xiàng zài tiāntáng yīyàng.
examples.english: On a summer night, feeling the cool breeze in the yard and enjoying the beautiful stars in the sky, it's virtually like being in heaven.

examples.chinese: 哥哥去超市買了一袋玉米和兩包麵條，要為家人準備晚餐。
examples.pinyin: Gēge qù chāoshì mǎi le yí dài yùmǐ hé liǎng bāo miàntiáo, yào wèi jiārén zhǔnbèi wǎncān.
examples.english: My older brother went to the supermarket and bought a bag of corn and two packs of noodles, to prepare dinner for the family.

items.wordHook: a 日(sun) plans a 免(escape) from the sky → 晚(evening).

examples.chinese: 到國外生活以前，得先找租房子的資料。山本良介覺得在台灣生活的費用(生活費)不太高，日本的比較高。
examples.pinyin: Dào guówài shēnghuó yǐqián, děi xiān zhǎo zū fángzi de zīliào. Shānběn Liángjiè juéde zài Táiwān shēnghuó de fèiyòng (shēnghuófèi) bù tài gāo, Rìběn de bǐjiào gāo.
examples.english: Before going abroad to live, you must first find information about renting a place. Yamamoto Ryosuke feels that the cost of living in Taiwan is not very high; Japan's is higher.

examples.chinese: 就要開會了，可是我同事還沒把新產品的說明資料準備好，真叫人緊張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù yào kāihuì le, kěshì wǒ tóngshì hái méi bǎ xīn chǎnpǐn de shuōmíng zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, zhēn jiào rén jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The meeting is about to start, but my colleague still hasn't prepared the explanatory materials for the new product, which really makes one nervous.

examples.chinese: A:你知道辦理留學的手續需要準備哪些資料嗎？ B:我不清楚。你可以上網查查。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zhīdào bànlǐ liúxué de shǒuxù xūyào zhǔnbèi nǎxiē zīliào ma? B: Wǒ bù qīngchu. Nǐ kěyǐ shàngwǎng cháchá.
examples.english: A: Do you know what materials need to be prepared to deal with the procedures for studying abroad? B: I'm not sure. You can look it up online.

examples.chinese: 報名衝浪課的手續很簡單，只要到辦公室填一張基本資料表就行了。
examples.pinyin: Bàomíng chōnglàng kè de shǒuxù hěn jiǎndān, zhǐyào dào bàngōngshì tián yī zhāng jīběn zīliào biǎo jiù xíng le.
examples.english: The procedure for registering for the surfing class is very simple; you just need to go to the office and fill out one basic information form.

examples.chinese: 有一些交友網站上的個人姓名、年齡等資料都是假的，所以上網交友要小心。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē jiāoyǒu wǎngzhàn shàng de gèrén xìngmíng, niánlíng děng zīliào dōu shì jiǎ de, suǒyǐ shàngwǎng jiāoyǒu yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: Some personal information such as names and ages on dating websites is false, so you need to be careful when making friends online.

examples.chinese: 有了無線網路，就可以隨時隨地上網查資料、看影片，或是玩遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le wúxiàn wǎnglù, jiù kěyǐ suíshísuídì shàngwǎng chá zīliào, kàn yǐngpiàn, huòshì wán yóuxì.
examples.english: With wireless internet, you can go online anytime, anywhere to look up information, watch videos, or play games.

examples.chinese: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin: Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english: That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好。為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi yīnwèi míngtiān yào qù dàxué miànshì, jǐnzhāng de zhěnggè wǎnshang dōu shuì bù hǎo. Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì de miànshì, wǒ kàn le hěnduō xiāngguān zīliào, hái búduàn de liànxí miànshì shí gēn zhǔguǎn de duìhuà.
examples.english: Because my younger brother is going to a university interview tomorrow, he was so nervous that he couldn't sleep well the whole night. In order to prepare for this interview, I read a lot of related information and also constantly practiced the conversation with the manager during the interview.

examples.chinese: 公司的會議資料都存在雲端，這樣又安全又方便，各部門也能隨時參考。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de huìyì zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, zhèyàng yòu ānquán yòu fāngbiàn, gè bùmén yě néng suíshí cānkǎo.
examples.english: The company's meeting materials are all stored in the cloud; this way it is both safe and convenient, and each department can also refer to them at any time.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，面試時要準備的相關文件包括個人基本資料、畢業證書等等。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, miànshì shí yào zhǔnbèi de xiāngguān wénjiàn bāokuò gèrén jīběn zīliào, bìyè zhèngshū děngděng.
examples.english: Generally speaking, the relevant documents to prepare for an interview include basic personal information, graduation certificate, and so on.

examples.chinese: 我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le. A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english: I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home. A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議資料我已經上傳到雲端，請各位開會前先了解要討論的內容。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì zīliào wǒ yǐjīng shàngchuán dào yúnduān, qǐng gèwèi kāihuì qián xiān liǎojiě yào tǎolùn de nèiróng.
examples.english: I have already uploaded tomorrow's meeting materials to the cloud; please understand the content to be discussed before the meeting.

examples.chinese: 有一些網路上的資料或影片是被保護的，不能隨便下載。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē wǎnglù shàng de zīliào huò yǐngpiàn shì bèi bǎohù de, bùnéng suíbiàn xiàzài.
examples.english: Some materials or videos on the internet are protected and cannot be downloaded casually.

examples.chinese: 老師先把跟課程相關的學習資料上傳到雲端，讓學生預習。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiān bǎ gēn kèchéng xiāngguān de xuéxí zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí.
examples.english: The teacher first uploads the course-related learning materials to the cloud for students to preview.

examples.chinese: 現在的電腦處理資料的速度比以往快得多，功能也更多了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de diànnǎo chǔlǐ zīliào de sùdù bǐ yǐwǎng kuài de duō, gōngnéng yě gèng duō le.
examples.english: Today's computers process data much faster than in the past, and have more functions.

examples.chinese: 幸虧你來幫忙，要不然我一個人絕對忙不過來。幸虧我把資料都存在雲端，要不然找不到隨身碟，怎麼開會呢？
examples.pinyin: 1. Xìngkuī nǐ lái bāngmáng, yàobùrán wǒ yí ge rén juéduì máng bú guòlái. 2. Xìngkuī wǒ bǎ zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàobùrán zhǎo bú dào suíshēndié, zěnme kāihuì ne?
examples.english: 1. Thanks to your help, otherwise I definitely wouldn't be able to handle it alone. 2. Fortunately, I saved all the data in the cloud; otherwise, if I couldn't find the USB drive, how could we have the meeting?

examples.chinese: 我的歷史作業寫完了，同時也把明天要報告的古蹟資料準備好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de lìshǐ zuòyè xiě wán le, tóngshí yě bǎ míngtiān yào bàogào de gǔjì zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
examples.english: I finished my history homework, and at the same time I also prepared the information on historical sites for tomorrow's report.

examples.chinese: 歷史系的李教授最近經常接受記者的訪問，因此變得很有名。那名記者為了訪問總統外交、貿易等方面的問題，閱讀了許多相關的資料。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ xì de Lǐ jiàoshòu zuìjìn jīngcháng jiēshòu jìzhě de fǎngwèn, yīncǐ biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Nà míng jìzhě wèile fǎngwèn zǒngtǒng wàijiāo, màoyì děng fāngmiàn de wèntí, yuèdú le xǔduō xiāngguān de zīliào.
examples.english: Professor Li from the History Department has recently often been interviewed by reporters, and therefore has become very famous. That reporter, in order to interview the president about questions on diplomacy, trade, and other aspects, read a lot of related materials.

examples.chinese: 以前人們常用磁帶來存電腦的重要資料。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián rénmen cháng yòng cídài lái cún diànnǎo de zhòngyào zīliào.
examples.english: In the past, people often used magnetic tape to store important computer data.

examples.chinese: 這幾箱書都是我念過的課本跟參考資料，打算送給育幼院的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ xiāng shū dōu shì wǒ niàn guò de kèběn gēn cānkǎo zīliào, dǎsuàn sòng gěi yùyòuyuàn de háizi.
examples.english: These few boxes of books are all textbooks and reference materials I've studied; I plan to give them to the children at the orphanage.

examples.chinese: 他的獎學金申請書因少了一份資料，已被學校退回。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jiǎngxuéjīn shēnqǐngshū yīn shǎo le yī fèn zīliào, yǐ bèi xuéxiào tuìhuí.
examples.english: His scholarship application was returned by the school because it was missing one document.

examples.chinese: 會議資料的分類不必太仔細，分得簡單清楚就行了。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì zīliào de fēnlèi bùbì tài zǐxì, fēn de jiǎndān qīngchu jiù xíng le.
examples.english: The classification of meeting materials doesn't need to be too detailed; as long as it's simple and clear, that's fine.

examples.chinese: 上臺報告以前要把資料準備好，以免到時候手忙腳亂的。
examples.pinyin: Shàngtái bàogào yǐqián yào bǎ zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, yǐmiǎn dào shíhou shǒumángjiǎoluàn de.
examples.english: Before going on stage to give a report, you need to prepare your materials well, so that you won't be in a rush and confused when the time comes.

examples.chinese: 根據目前科學研究的資料，女性與男性在能力、態度和行為等方面的差異都非常小。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù mùqián kēxué yánjiū de zīliào, nǚxìng yǔ nánxìng zài nénglì, tàidù hé xíngwéi děng fāngmiàn de chāyì dōu fēicháng xiǎo.
examples.english: According to current scientific research data, the differences between women and men in aspects such as ability, attitude, and behavior are all very small.

examples.chinese: 根據美國某項研究資料，青少年因腦震盪而被送到醫院的意外中，超過一半是因為激烈運動引起的。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù Měiguó mǒu xiàng yánjiū zīliào, qīngshàonián yīn nǎozhèndàng ér bèi sòng dào yīyuàn de yìwài zhōng, chāoguò yībàn shì yīnwèi jīliè yùndòng yǐnqǐ de.
examples.english: According to a certain American research study, among accidents in which teenagers are sent to the hospital due to cerebral concussion, more than half are caused by intense sports.

examples.chinese: 根據氣象資料，這個颱風未來兩天會往西移動，週五起對台灣產生影響。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù qìxiàng zīliào, zhège táifēng wèilái liǎng tiān huì wǎng xī yídòng, zhōuwǔ qǐ duì Táiwān chǎnshēng yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: According to meteorological data, this typhoon will move westward over the next two days and will begin to affect Taiwan from Friday.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的效率真差，有人竟然沒看資料就來了，真是誇張。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de xiàolǜ zhēn chà, yǒu rén jìngrán méi kàn zīliào jiù lái le, zhēn shì kuāzhāng.
examples.english: The efficiency of this meeting is really poor; someone surprisingly came without even looking at the materials—that's really outrageous.

examples.chinese: 假如擔心弄丟重要的資料，可複製一份存在電腦裡。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú dānxīn nòngdiū zhòngyào de zīliào, kě fùzhì yī fèn cún zài diànnǎo lǐ.
examples.english: If you are worried about losing important data, you can make a copy and save it on the computer.

examples.chinese: 申請簽證的表格請填完整資料，以免無法順利申請。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng qiānzhèng de biǎogé qǐng tián wánzhěng zīliào, yǐmiǎn wúfǎ shùnlì shēnqǐng.
examples.english: Please fill out the visa application form with complete information, so as to avoid being unable to apply successfully.

examples.chinese: 公司的生產部門這個月規劃了員工旅遊，有三個不同地點讓大家選擇。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de shēngchǎn bùmén zhège yuè guīhuà le yuángōng lǚyóu, yǒu sān ge bùtóng dìdiǎn ràng dàjiā xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The company's production department planned an employee trip this month, with three different locations for everyone to choose from.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The travel itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as sightseeing, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The tour itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as visiting, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 結婚之前，那對情侶認真規劃了未來的生活，沒想到結婚一個月之後就離婚了。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn zhīqián, nà duì qínglǚ rènzhēn guīhuà le wèilái de shēnghuó, méi xiǎngdào jiéhūn yí ge yuè zhīhòu jiù líhūn le.
examples.english: Before getting married, that couple carefully planned their future life; unexpectedly, they divorced just one month after getting married.

examples.chinese: 每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去。導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de yīshēng dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guīhuà, rìzi cái bù huì báibái de guòqù. Dǎoyóu wàng le gēn Xiǎo Tāng yuēhǎo zài Hóngmáochéng ménkǒu jiànmiàn, hài tā bái (bái) děng le yī gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Everyone should plan their life well so that days won't pass for nothing. The tour guide forgot to agree to meet Xiao Tang at the entrance of Fort San Domingo, causing him to wait in vain for an hour.

examples.chinese: 政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuì zhǔyào de rènwu yīng shì wéichí bìng bǎohù shèhuì ānquán, qícì shì guīhuà gè zhǒng zhìdù, shǐ guójiā wěndìng de chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: The government's most main task should be to maintain and protect social security; next is to plan various systems so that the country can grow stably.

examples.chinese: 這個地區的路規劃得不太理想，不僅沒有一條是直的，方向也有點兒亂，很容易就迷路了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dìqū de lù guīhuà de bú tài lǐxiǎng, bùjǐn méiyǒu yì tiáo shì zhí de, fāngxiàng yě yǒudiǎnr luàn, hěn róngyì jiù mílù le.
examples.english: The roads in this area are not planned very ideally; not only is there not a single straight one, but the directions are also a bit chaotic, so it's easy to get lost.

examples.chinese: 有時一個人的前途無法先規劃好，必須自己創造。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushí yī gè rén de qiántú wúfǎ xiān guīhuà hǎo, bìxū zìjǐ chuàngzào.
examples.english: Sometimes a person's prospects cannot be planned out in advance; one must create them oneself.

examples.chinese: 我旅行的方式很隨意，出發前從不先規劃行程。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lǚxíng de fāngshì hěn suíyì, chūfā qián cóng bù xiān guīhuà xíngchéng.
examples.english: My way of traveling is very much as I wish; before setting out, I never plan the itinerary in advance.

examples.chinese: 她推動學習革命，讓學生主動參與規劃課程。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuīdòng xuéxí gémìng, ràng xuéshēng zhǔdòng cānyǔ guīhuà kèchéng.
examples.english: She promoted a learning revolution, letting students actively participate in planning the curriculum.

examples.chinese: 這次期末考的題目很難，大家的成績都不好，還有幾個人被當了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qīmò kǎo de tímù hěn nán, dàjiā de chéngjì dōu bù hǎo, hái yǒu jǐ ge rén bèi dāng le.
examples.english: The questions on this final exam were very difficult; everyone’s grades were bad, and several people even failed the course.

examples.chinese: 老師說這次口試的題目不難，回答是只要放輕鬆、別緊張，就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō zhè cì kǒushì de tímù bù nán, huídá shì zhǐyào fàng qīngsōng, bié jǐnzhāng, jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: The teacher said the questions on this oral exam are not hard; the answer is that as long as you relax and don't be nervous, there's no problem.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 這次數學考試的題目似乎難了點，因為超過三分之二的學生考不及格。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shùxué kǎoshì de tímù sìhū nán le diǎn, yīnwèi chāoguò sān fēn zhī èr de xuéshēng kǎo bù jígé.
examples.english: The questions on this math exam seem a bit difficult, because more than two-thirds of the students failed.

examples.chinese: 明天要考五科，每科的測驗題目各有五十題，我想今天晚上得開夜車了。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎo wǔ kē, měi kē de cèyàn tímù gè yǒu wǔshí tí, wǒ xiǎng jīntiān wǎnshang děi kāi yèchē le.
examples.english: Tomorrow I have exams in five subjects; each subject has fifty test questions, so I think tonight I'll have to burn the midnight oil.

examples.chinese: 這個題目怪難的，連老師都要想很久。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge tímù guài nán de, lián lǎoshī dōu yào xiǎng hěn jiǔ.
examples.english: This question is quite difficult; even the teacher has to think about it for a long time.

examples.chinese: 老師問的題目太難，大家只好望著老師，看老師怎麼回答。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī wèn de tímù tài nán, dàjiā zhǐhǎo wàng zhe lǎoshī, kàn lǎoshī zěnme huídá.
examples.english: The question the teacher asked was too difficult, so everyone could only gaze at the teacher to see how the teacher would answer.

items.wordHook: Combining 題(forehead) and 目(eye): 題目 means exam question, title.

examples.chinese: 打仗期間，許多軍人為國家犧牲了寶貴的生命，也給家人留下了痛苦的記憶。
examples.pinyin: Dǎzhàng qījiān, xǔduō jūnrén wèi guójiā xīshēngle bǎoguì de shēngmìng, yě gěi jiārén liúxiàle tòngkǔ de jìyì.
examples.english: During the war, many soldiers sacrificed their precious lives for the country, and also left painful memories for their families.

items.wordHook: To 打(attack) a 仗(1to rely upon): 打仗 means fight a war.

examples.chinese: 有人以為身體沒什麼毛病就代表很健康，這樣的想法事實上不完全正確。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén yǐwéi shēntǐ méi shénme máobìng jiù dàibiǎo hěn jiànkāng, zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ shìshíshàng bù wánquán zhèngquè.
examples.english: Some people think that if the body has no problems, it means being very healthy; in fact, this idea is not entirely correct.

examples.chinese: 天氣變涼了，奶奶頭痛的毛病又犯了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì biàn liáng le, nǎinai tóutòng de máobìng yòu fàn le.
examples.english: The weather has turned cool, and Grandma's headache problem has occurred again.

examples.chinese: 母親為家人親手織了幾件毛衣，希望讓大家過個溫暖的冬天。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīn wèi jiārén qīnshǒu zhī le jǐ jiàn máoyī, xīwàng ràng dàjiā guò ge wēnnuǎn de dōngtiān.
examples.english: Mother personally knitted several sweaters for the family, hoping to let everyone have a warm winter.

examples.chinese: 林伯伯覺得最近身體的毛病不少，可是說也奇怪，醫生檢查後都說他很正常。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo juéde zuìjìn shēntǐ de máobìng bù shǎo, kěshì shuō yě qíguài, yīshēng jiǎnchá hòu dōu shuō tā hěn zhèngcháng.
examples.english: Uncle Lin feels that he has quite a few health problems recently, but strange to say, after the doctor's examination, they all say he is very normal.

examples.chinese: 我爺爺年紀大了，不但體力不好，還有頭痛、肩膀痛的毛病。我家的洗衣機用了二十多年了，毛病真不少，可是媽媽還不肯換新的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye niánjì dà le, bùdàn tǐlì bù hǎo, hái yǒu tóutòng, jiānbǎng tòng de máobìng. Wǒ jiā de xǐyījī yòng le èrshí duō nián le, máobìng zhēn bù shǎo, kěshì māma hái bù kěn huàn xīn de.
examples.english: My grandpa is old; not only is his physical strength poor, but he also has the problem of headaches and shoulder pain. Our washing machine has been used for over twenty years and has quite a few problems, but Mom still won't agree to replace it with a new one.

examples.chinese: 大衣、毛衣、外套等服裝，這家店都賣。學中文，聽、說、讀、寫等四個部分，都需要多練習。
examples.pinyin: Dàyī, máoyī, wàitào děng fúzhuāng, zhè jiā diàn dōu mài. Xué Zhōngwén, tīng, shuō, dú, xiě děng sì gè bùfèn, dōu xūyào duō liànxí.
examples.english: This store sells clothing such as coats, sweaters, and jackets. In learning Chinese, the four parts—listening, speaking, reading, and writing—all require a lot of practice.

examples.chinese: 美國的一毛錢差不多是台灣的三塊錢。
examples.pinyin: Měiguó de yī máo qián chàbuduō shì Táiwān de sān kuài qián.
examples.english: One dime in the US is about three dollars in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 明天有書法課，我要帶毛筆去學校。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu shūfǎ kè, wǒ yào dài máobǐ qù xuéxiào.
examples.english: Tomorrow there is calligraphy class; I need to bring a brush to school.

examples.chinese: 我明天要上書法課，現在要去買毛筆！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yào shàng shūfǎ kè, xiànzài yào qù mǎi máobǐ!
examples.english: I have calligraphy class tomorrow; I need to go buy a writing brush now!

examples.chinese: 每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去。導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de yīshēng dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guīhuà, rìzi cái bù huì báibái de guòqù. Dǎoyóu wàng le gēn Xiǎo Tāng yuēhǎo zài Hóngmáochéng ménkǒu jiànmiàn, hài tā bái (bái) děng le yī gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Everyone should plan their life well so that days won't pass for nothing. The tour guide forgot to agree to meet Xiao Tang at the entrance of Fort San Domingo, causing him to wait in vain for an hour.

examples.chinese: 有些運動中心規定個人得帶自己的毛巾，否則不可以進去。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē yùndòng zhōngxīn guīdìng gèrén děi dài zìjǐ de máojīn, fǒuzé bù kěyǐ jìnqù.
examples.english: Some sports centers require individuals to bring their own towels; otherwise, they cannot enter.

items.wordHook: 二(two) strands twirl together and flick out a tail → 毛(hair).
Combining 碼(number) and 頭(the first): 碼頭 means pier.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 他靠自己的力量，經過了十年，終於完成了這個發明。
examples.pinyin: Tā kào zìjǐ de lìliàng, jīngguò le shí nián, zhōngyú wánchéng le zhège fāmíng.
examples.english: Relying on his own strength, after ten years, he finally completed this invention.

examples.chinese: 人們為了節省勞力，發明了許多實用的機械。
examples.pinyin: Rénmen wèile jiéshěng láolì, fāmíng le xǔduō shíyòng de jīxiè.
examples.english: In order to save labor, people invented many practical machines.

examples.chinese: 這項新發明解決了許多環保問題，發明的人還受國家表揚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng xīn fāmíng jiějué le xǔduō huánbǎo wèntí, fāmíng de rén hái shòu guójiā biǎoyáng.
examples.english: This new invention solved many environmental problems, and the inventor was even praised by the country.

examples.chinese: 在國外遇見好久沒聯絡的好友，是一件很開心的事情。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài yùjiàn hǎojiǔ méi liánluò de hǎoyǒu, shì yī jiàn hěn kāixīn de shìqing.
examples.english: Meeting a good friend you haven't contacted for a long time abroad is a very happy thing.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，幸福就是在身邊有一群願意互相幫助的好友。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, xìngfú jiùshì zài shēnbiān yǒu yī qún yuànyì hùxiāng bāngzhù de hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: To me, happiness is having a group of good friends around who are willing to help each other.

examples.chinese: 透過社群網站，我們可以加入感興趣的社團，讓自己的生活更充實。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, wǒmen kěyǐ jiārù gǎn xìngqù de shètuán, ràng zìjǐ de shēnghuó gèng chōngshí.
examples.english: Through social media, we can join clubs we are interested in, making our lives more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 這個山區種了許多茶樹，到了收穫季節，就會有一群採茶姑娘上山採茶。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shānqū zhòng le xǔduō cháshù, dào le shōuhuò jìjié, jiù huì yǒu yī qún cǎi chá gūniang shàngshān cǎi chá.
examples.english: Many tea trees are planted in this mountainous area; when the harvest season comes, a group of tea-picking girls will go up the mountain to pick tea.

examples.chinese: 資源回收不分你我他，一個人的回收是榜樣，一群人的回收是力量。
examples.pinyin: Zīyuán huíshōu bù fēn nǐ wǒ tā, yī ge rén de huíshōu shì bǎngyàng, yī qún rén de huíshōu shì lìliàng.
examples.english: Resource recycling does not distinguish between you, me, and others; one person’s recycling is an example, and a group of people’s recycling is power.

examples.chinese: 每次當我回憶起大學的社團生活，就會想到那一群知心好友。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì dāng wǒ huíyì qǐ dàxué de shètuán shēnghuó, jiù huì xiǎngdào nà yī qún zhīxīn hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: Every time I recall my university club life, I think of that group of close friends.

examples.chinese: 到機場時看見一群戲迷正追著電影明星照相，真有意思。
examples.pinyin: Dào jīchǎng shí kànjiàn yī qún xìmí zhèng zhuī zhe diànyǐng míngxīng zhàoxiàng, zhēn yǒu yìsi.
examples.english: When I arrived at the airport, I saw a group of theater fans chasing after a movie star to take photos; it was really interesting.

examples.chinese: 國際棒球比賽快開始了，那一群剛入棒球場、穿藍色運動服的就是臺灣隊。
examples.pinyin: Guójì bàngqiú bǐsài kuài kāishǐ le, nà yì qún gāng jìnrù bàngqiúchǎng, chuān lánsè yùndòngfú de jiùshì Táiwān duì.
examples.english: The international baseball game is about to start; that group that just entered the baseball field wearing blue sportswear is the Taiwan team.

examples.chinese: 對自己的事業很熱情的人，就不怕挑戰任何困難。
examples.pinyin: Duì zìjǐ de shìyè hěn rèqíng de rén, jiù bù pà tiǎozhàn rènhé kùnnán.
examples.english: People who are very passionate about their careers are not afraid to challenge any difficulties.

examples.chinese: 能得到觀眾熱情掌聲的表演，才算是有魅力的表演。
examples.pinyin: Néng dédào guānzhòng rèqíng zhǎngshēng de biǎoyǎn, cái suànshì yǒu mèilì de biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: Only a performance that can receive enthusiastic applause from the audience is considered to be a charming performance.

examples.chinese: 要前往國外旅行，得先確認當地現在的氣候，好收拾行李。
examples.pinyin: Yào qiánwǎng guówài lǚxíng, děi xiān quèrèn dāngdì xiànzài de qìhòu, hǎo shōushí xínglǐ.
examples.english: To go abroad for travel, you must first confirm the local current climate so as to pack your luggage.
